title: Unifying Physical Backpropagation
summary: Physical computing systems exploit device dynamics for computation, but their gradient-based optimization is challenging: backpropagation through a digital twin suffers from model-reality gap. On-device gradient computation could resolve this issue, and a handful of theoretical and experimental studies have proposed ways to achieve it. Yet a unifying theory identifying when a physical system can compute the gradient of its own performance has been missing. Here we develop such a unification, based on the adjoint method: we identify sufficient conditions under which the adjoint field required for formally exact gradients can be generated on the same hardware that performs the computation. Linear and nonlinear systems obey fundamentally different conditions: for linear systems damping or gain is admissible provided reciprocity is preserved. For nonlinear trajectory systems the sufficient conditions are reciprocity of the linearized system and the existence of a time-reversal mirror. Algorithmically, the nonlinear case requires infinitesimal nudging, whereas linear systems admit a finite-amplitude experiment. We recover Equilibrium Propagation, Hamiltonian echo backpropagation, fully forward mode training and in situ gradient methods in integrated-photonic and free-space-optical systems. We further show that reciprocity is only the simplest instance of a more general intertwining condition, which extends exact on-device gradient computation to a class of non-Hermitian, non-reciprocal systems. Further generalizations include time-dependent parameters, Onsager-reciprocal dynamics and nonlinear, PT-symmetric Schrödinger equations. Our work provides a unified theoretical basis for formally exact physical learning algorithms and a template for constructing them across a range of physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于伴随方法提出了一套统一理论，阐明了物理计算系统在何种条件下能够在其自身硬件上计算精确梯度，识别了线性和非线性系统的不同充分条件，并统一了多种现有物理学习算法。
AI.motivation: 物理计算系统利用器件动力学进行计算，但其基于梯度的优化面临数字孪生模型与现实系统之间的鸿沟。虽然在设备上直接计算梯度有望解决这一问题，且已有少量理论与实验研究，但缺乏一个统一的框架来判定何时物理系统能在自身硬件上计算其性能的梯度。
AI.method: 以伴随方法为核心工具，推导出物理系统在其自身硬件上生成伴随场的充分条件。将线性系统与非线性轨迹系统分别处理：线性系统需要保持互易性（reciprocity），允许阻尼或增益；非线性系统需要线性化系统的互易性以及时间反演镜的存在。进一步推广到更一般的交织条件（intertwining condition），覆盖非厄米、非互易系统，以及含时参数、Onsager互易动力学和非线性PT对称薛定谔方程。
AI.result: 该统一理论恢复了平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）、哈密顿回波反向传播（Hamiltonian echo backpropagation）、全前向模式训练以及集成光子学与自由空间光学系统中的原位梯度方法。算法上，非线性情况需要无穷小的微扰（nudging），而线性系统允许有限幅度实验。互易性仅是更一般的交织条件中最简单的实例，该条件将精确的片上梯度计算扩展到更广泛的物理系统类别。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为形式上精确的物理学习算法提供了统一的理论基础，并为跨多种物理系统构建此类算法提供了模板，填补了该领域缺乏统一理论的空白。

title: Logarithmically Correlated Landscapes and Localization in Non-Hermitian Quasicrystals
summary: We study a one-dimensional Hatano-Nelson ring whose nonreciprocal hopping is quasiperiodically modulated through zero. A gauge transformation maps every eigenstate onto a single spatial envelope, whose logarithm becomes a deterministic, logarithmically correlated field once the hopping vanishes along the quasiperiodic orbit. We derive an exact Fourier representation and prove that the landscape variance grows logarithmically with system size, with a stiffness set by the modulation power and the arithmetic of the incommensurate frequency. The extended phase terminates at an algebraic boundary given by Jensen's formula. Inside the singular regime, localization requires the stiffness to exceed a critical threshold: above it, the wavefunction weight concentrates on the few highest landscape peaks and the state is localized; below it, the weight spreads over too many competing peaks and the state is a critical multifractal. The extreme-value statistics are anomalous: peak gaps grow as a power of the logarithm of rank, with an exponent that encodes the continued-fraction type of the frequency, distinct from the Anderson, Aubry-André, and random-gauge universality classes. The stiffness adds across channels in multiband lattices, and all signatures survive percent-level component disorder, placing the mechanism within reach of nonreciprocal topolectrical circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维准周期调制Hatano-Nelson环，通过规范变换将每个本征态映射到单一空间包络，其对数成为确定性的对数相关场。证明了景观方差随系统尺寸对数增长，确定了扩展相以Jensen公式给出的代数边界终止，并揭示奇异区内局域化需刚度超过临界阈值，否则为critical multifractal态。极值统计异常，峰间距随秩的对数次方增长，编码频率的连分数类型，与Anderson、Aubry-André等普适类不同。刚度在多带晶格中跨通道叠加，所有特征在百分级无序下仍存活。
AI.motivation: 理解准周期非互易跃迁通过零时（跃迁在准周期轨道上消失）的一维Hatano-Nelson环中波函数局域化与临界现象的机制，特别是扩展相的终止边界和奇异区内的定位特征。
AI.method: 利用规范变换将本征态映射为单一空间包络，将对数包络视为确定性对数相关随机场；推导精确Fourier表示并证明景观方差对数增长；结合Jensen公式确定扩展相边界；通过极值统计和刚度临界阈值分析局域化与multifractal相变。
AI.result: 景观方差以系统尺寸对数增长，刚度由调制功率和无理频率的算术决定；扩展相以Jensen公式代数边界终止；刚度超过临界阈值则局域化，否则为critical multifractal；峰间距以对数秩的幂增长，指数编码频率连分数类型，区别于已知普适类；刚度跨通道叠加，百分级无序下特征仍存。
AI.conclusion: 该机制构成一类新的无随机性但具有对数相关场的局域化-临界普适类，可由非互易topolectrical电路实验验证，填补了Anderson、Aubry-André与随机规范普适类之间的空白。

title: Accurate Evaluation of Nanoscale Spatiotemporal Dynamics with Electron Correlation Microscopy
summary: Electron correlation microscopy (ECM) can measure materials dynamics with nanoscale spatial resolution from intensity correlation functions. However, adopting X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) normalization frameworks unchanged when calculating intensity correlations can introduce errors. Due to the constrained sampling volumes and larger speckle sizes in nanobeam electron diffraction, XPCS-style time-averaging and scattering-vector averaging introduce systematic artifacts, such as artificial anticorrelations or elevated baselines that lead to systematic errors in structural relaxation times and stretching exponents. This work presents physics-inspired, ECM-specific intensity normalizations over time- and azimuthal-averaged intensities of the first diffraction ring that limit those errors. The framework is validated using molecular dynamics simulations of a CuZr supercooled liquid to benchmark against the self intermediate scattering function, successfully reproducing relaxation times. When applied to experimental time-resolved 4D STEM datasets of a Pt57.5Cu14.7Ni5.3P22.5 nanowire, the method correctly identifies highly stable, unchanging nanoscale crystalline phases that were erroneously misclassified as relaxing domains by previous frameworks. Other previous ECM research is reevaluated in light of these observation. This robust approach establishes an artifact-free pathway for evaluating localized spatiotemporal relaxation behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对电子相关显微镜（ECM）的物理启发的强度归一化框架，通过使用第一衍射环的时间平均和方位角平均强度进行归一化，避免了直接套用X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS）归一化框架所带来的系统误差（如人为反相关、基线抬升），从而准确测量纳米尺度材料的结构弛豫时间和拉伸指数。
AI.motivation: ECM虽能以纳米级空间分辨率测量材料动力学，但直接沿用XPCS的归一化框架计算强度相关函数会引入误差。由于纳米束电子衍射中采样体积受限、散斑尺寸较大，XPCS式的时间平均和散射矢量平均会产生伪非相关或基线抬升等系统伪影，导致结构弛豫时间和拉伸指数的系统性误差，亟需一种专门针对ECM的归一化方案。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种ECM专用的强度归一化方法：基于第一衍射环的时间平均强度和方位角平均强度进行归一化来替代XPCS标准框架。通过CuZr过冷液体的分子动力学模拟验证该方法，以自中间散射函数为基准；同时将该方法应用于Pt57.5Cu14.7Ni5.3P22.5纳米线的时间分辨4D STEM实验数据集。
AI.result: 在CuZr模拟中，新框架成功复现了弛豫时间，与自中间散射函数基准一致。在Pt57.5Cu14.7Ni5.3P22.5纳米线的实验数据中，该方法正确识别出高度稳定、恒定的纳米晶相——这些相在先前框架中被误分类为弛豫域。此外，作者还据此重新评估了此前其他ECM研究的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该稳健的归一化框架为评估局部时空弛豫行为提供了无伪影的途径，为ECM数据分析建立了更可靠的标准，纠正常规XPCS框架在纳米束电子衍射条件下的系统性偏差。

title: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians
summary: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with $\sim0.5$B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. To do this, we formulate $\text{spin-}1/2$ quantum ground-state learning as manifold variational optimisation over centrally odd scalar functions on $\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$. This replaces explicit Hilbert-space vector amplitudes with manifold functions on which the Hamiltonian acts through Lie derivatives, evaluated by custom automatic differentiation primitives. We prove that the resulting variational principle on this manifold preserves the $\text{spin-}1/2$ sector's ground-state upper bound using the Peter-Weyl theorem, then pre-train our foundation model on a dataset of hundreds of thousands of different Hamiltonian systems, varying the connection topology, system size, interaction types and strengths, bringing together a century of many-body literature. Using a novel $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ replica-exchange Langevin sampler and sharded natural-gradient optimisation, we train our model with our own extension of the Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (KFAC) optimiser on system sizes up to 64 qubits. On a held-out generalisation dataset, we fine-tune our model on system sizes of up to 1024 qubits, and evaluate on systems up to 8100 qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于~0.5B变分参数的量子基础模型，通过将自旋-1/2量子基态问题表述为SU(2)^N流形上的变分优化，结合大语言模型和深度强化学习技术进行训练，可有效摊销任意且通用的哈密顿系统集合的基态计算问题。模型在多达64量子比特的规模上训练，微调至1024量子比特，最终评估尺度达8100量子比特。
AI.motivation: 量子计算的核心承诺之一是能够计算经典模拟方法无法企及的哈密顿系统基态。作者希望利用基础模型范式（如大语言模型）将这一问题在任意且通用的哈密顿集合上进行摊销，从而突破传统逐一求解的范式局限。
AI.method: (1) 将自旋-1/2量子基态学习表述为SU(2)^N上中心奇标量函数的流形变分优化，用流形函数取代显式希尔伯特空间矢量振幅；(2) 哈密顿量通过李导数作用在流形函数上，由自定义自动微分原语计算；(3) 利用Peter-Weyl定理证明该变分原理保持自旋-1/2扇区基态上界；(4) 在数十万不同哈密顿系统（变化连接拓扑、系统尺寸、相互作用类型和强度）上预训练基础模型；(5) 使用新颖的SU(2)副本交换Langevin采样器和分片自然梯度优化，以及对KFAC优化器的扩展进行训练。
AI.result: 模型在系统规模上展示了显著的扩展能力：训练规模达64量子比特，在保留的泛化数据集上微调至1024量子比特，并在高达8100量子比特的系统上进行了评估。数据涵盖了近一个世纪的少体/多体文献中的各类哈密顿系统。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，借助当代大语言模型和深度强化学习技术训练的基础模型，能够将量子基态计算问题在广泛的哈密顿系统集合上进行有效摊销，为实用量子优势的实现提供了新的路径。

title: Symbolic Machine Learning for Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Prediction in Cx-N2 Binary Mixtures
summary: Accurate prediction of vapor--liquid equilibrium (VLE) for hydrocarbon-nitrogen mixtures remains challenging for cubic equations of state, particularly across broad ranges of composition and hydrocarbon chain length. While deep learning models can provide accurate predictions, they often lack interpretability and explicit analytical expressions. In this work, we propose a symbolic machine learning approach to discover interpretable symbolic corrections to Peng-Robinson equation-of-state (PR-EOS) predictions from experimental data. The proposed approach adopts a two-level strategy: symbolic expressions are first identified for individual hydrocarbon systems, after which their coefficients are represented as functions of carbon number to enable accurate prediction across different hydrocarbon systems. The results demonstrate significantly improved prediction accuracy over the original PR-EOS across all hydrocarbon-nitrogen systems. Overall, the proposed approach provides an interpretable symbolic correction framework for improving PR-EOS predictions of hydrocarbon-nitrogen VLE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种符号机器学习方法，用于发现可解释的符号修正项来改进Peng-Robinson状态方程（PR-EOS）对烃-氮体系汽液平衡（VLE）的预测精度。该方法采用两级策略：先为单个烃体系识别符号表达式，再将其系数表示为碳原子数的函数，从而实现对不同烃体系的准确预测。结果表明，该方法在所有烃-氮体系上均显著优于原始PR-EOS，并提供了解释性的符号修正框架。
AI.motivation: 立方状态方程（如PR-EOS）在预测烃-氮混合物汽液平衡时精度不足，尤其在宽组成范围和烃链长度变化较大的情况下。虽然深度学习模型能提供准确预测，但缺乏可解释性和显式解析表达式，难以满足工程实际中对物理透明性的需求。
AI.method: 采用两级符号机器学习策略：(1) 首先为单个烃系统从实验数据中识别出符号修正表达式；(2) 然后将识别出的系数表示为碳原子数的函数，实现跨烃系统的泛化预测。该框架以PR-EOS基线预测为基准，通过符号回归发现显式的解析修正项。
AI.result: 在所有烃-氮体系中，该方法相比原始PR-EOS显著提升了VLE预测精度，同时保持了结果的解析可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可解释的符号修正框架，能够在保持解析表达式形式的前提下有效改进PR-EOS对烃-氮体系VLE的预测性能，弥合了传统状态方程与黑箱机器学习模型之间的差距。

title: Fine-Tuning Generative Models for Extreme Events via CVaR-Penalized Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: We propose CVaR-penalized Generative Particle Algorithm (CVaR-GPA), a robust, tail-agnostic algorithm for fine-tuning generative models to learn heavy-tailed distributions and capture extreme events, requiring no prior knowledge or estimation of the target's tail characteristics. The method is the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Lipschitz-regularized Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence penalized by a Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) discrepancy term: the Lipschitz-regularized KL divergence enables robust learning under minimal assumptions on the target distribution, while the CVaR penalty restores the velocity that otherwise vanishes prematurely in the under-sampled tails. The penalized flow admits a bounded but non-Lipschitz velocity field. This departs from the Lipschitz transport maps of standard generators, which preserve the tail behavior of a light-tailed source, and enables transport toward heavier-tailed targets. To define this flow on empirical measures, we derive the first-variation subgradients of CVaR from its Rockafellar-Uryasev representation, valid precisely where the classical density-based formula fails. The particle algorithm CVaR-GPA fine-tunes the output samples of any pre-trained model, without access to its architecture, and runs on an adaptive time horizon set by a kinetic-energy stopping criterion rather than a preset depth. On synthetic isotropic and anisotropic Student-$t$ target distributions, Neal's funnel distribution, and the real-world high-dimensional Fama-French 25 portfolio dataset, CVaR-GPA dramatically improves global and tail accuracy on heavy-tailed targets over the pre-trained baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出CVaR-GPA算法，一种鲁棒且尾部无关的生成模型微调方法，用于学习重尾分布和捕捉极端事件，无需先验知识或对目标尾部特征的估计。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型（如标准生成器）依赖Lipschitz传输映射，会保留轻尾源的尾部行为，难以向重尾目标分布传输。在欠采样尾部区域，速度场会过早消失，导致极端事件（尾部）学习不准确。现有方法需要预先了解目标分布的尾部特性，或依赖在大样本下失效的密度估计。
AI.method: 将Wasserstein梯度流应用于Lipschitz正则化的KL散度与CVaR差异项的惩罚组合。Lipschitz正则化KL散度在最小化目标分布假设下实现鲁棒学习；CVaR惩罚项恢复在欠采样尾部过早消失的速度场。该惩罚流产生有界但非Lipschitz的速度场，从而支持向更重尾目标的传输。从Rockafellar-Uryasev表示推导CVaR的第一变分次梯度，用于经验测度上的流定义。粒子算法在自适应时间范围上运行，由动能停止准则而非预设深度控制。
AI.result: 在合成各向同性和各向异性Student-t目标分布、Neal漏斗分布以及真实世界的高维Fama-French 25投资组合数据集上，CVaR-GPA相比预训练基线在重尾目标的全局精度和尾部精度上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: CVaR-GPA在无需先验尾部知识、无需访问预训练模型架构的情况下，展示了作为通用微调框架在重尾分布学习和极端事件捕捉方面的有效性。

title: Geometry of Noisy Quantum Many-Body Dynamics with Continuous Symmetries: Entanglement and Correlations
summary: We study unitary quantum dynamics in noisy Brownian models with global continuous symmetries, such as $U(1)$ and $SU(2)$, focusing on Rényi entanglement entropies and hydrodynamic and non-hydrodynamic correlators. By mapping the averaged late-time dynamics to the low-energy physics of effective replica Hamiltonians, we find that the evolution is controlled by the quantum geometry of their ground-state manifolds, which is directly related to the geometry of $k$-commutants---the symmetry algebra of $k$ replicas of the system. In interacting systems, these $k$-commutants are generically determined solely by the symmetries of the system, independent of microscopic details of the noisy evolution. This allows us to use the time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) to provide simple geometric explanations for the sub-ballistic Rényi entanglement growth and the anomalous decay of non-hydrodynamic correlators in interacting systems with continuous symmetries. We find this behavior to be intimately connected to singularities within the $k$-commutant manifolds, arising from frozen ``void'' states in the Hilbert space that exist due to continuous on-site symmetries. This also demystifies the important role of voids in the dynamics of these observables, previously identified in $U(1)$ symmetric systems. We compare these behaviors in interacting systems with Abelian and non-Abelian continuous symmetries and in free-fermion systems, which differ in the geometry of their $k$-commutants. Ultimately, this work provides a general geometric framework for systematically studying observables in noisy systems with continuous symmetries, including Haar-random circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有全局连续对称性（如U(1)和SU(2)）的噪声布朗模型中的酉量子动力学，重点关注Rényi纠缠熵及流体/非流体关联函数。通过将平均晚期动力学映射到有效复制哈密顿量的低能物理，作者发现演化受基态流形的量子几何控制，该几何与k-交换子（系统k个副本的对称代数）直接相关。利用含时变分原理（TDVP），作者为相互作用系统中亚弹道Rényi纠缠增长和非流体关联函数的反常衰减提供了简单的几何解释，并将其归因于k-交换子流形中的奇异性（源于连续在位对称性导致的冻结"空洞"态）。
AI.motivation: 理解具有连续对称性的量子多体系统中纠缠增长和关联函数演化的普适机制，特别是对称性如何在噪声动力学中主导观测量的晚期行为，并阐明先前在U(1)对称系统中发现的"空洞"态的角色。
AI.method: 将平均晚期动力学映射到有效复制哈密顿量的低能物理，建立与k-交换子（k副本对称代数）的量子几何联系；利用含时变分原理（TDVP）分析相互作用系统中k-交换子流形的几何性质，并对比阿贝尔/非阿贝尔连续对称系统及自由费米子系统的差异。
AI.result: 发现相互作用系统中k-交换子由系统对称性唯一确定，与噪声演化的微观细节无关；k-交换子流形中的奇异性（源于连续在位对称性导致的空洞态）是亚弹道Rényi纠缠增长和非流体关联函数反常衰减的几何根源；阿贝尔与非阿贝尔连续对称系统及自由费米子系统的k-交换子几何存在本质差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个通用的几何框架，可系统地研究具有连续对称性的噪声系统（包括Haar随机电路）中的可观测动力学，为理解对称性在纠缠增长和关联函数衰减中的作用提供了深刻见解，同时澄清了空洞态在这些动力学中的关键角色。

title: Quetzalcoatlite as a Disorder-Free Platform for Chiral Magnetism and Frustration
comment: 9 Pages, including 6 Figures, and additional four pages of Supplementary Information
summary: The natural mineral quetzalcoatlite Zn$_6$Cu$_3$(TeO$_6$)$_2$(OH)$_6$ $\cdot$ (Ag$_x$Pb$_y$Cl$_{x+2y}$) is a structurally ideal kagome magnet, providing a platform for exploring the interplay of geometric frustration, chirality, and tunability in a disorder-free framework. Here, we present the (first) comprehensive ab initio study of its electronic and magnetic properties. The electronic structure is dominated by localized half-filled Cu $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbitals that become insulating through electronic correlations. Mapping the low-energy physics onto a Heisenberg model reveals that the magnetism is governed primarily by two exchange interactions: a nearest-neighbor intralayer kagome coupling and a next-nearest-neighbor interlayer coupling. Their competition stabilizes an unconventional three-dimensional chiral magnetic state. Each kagome layer hosts a $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ order, while adjacent layers are rotated by $60^\circ$, producing a right-handed spiral along the crystallographic $c$-axis. This intrinsic chiral order emerges naturally from the crystal structure and magnetic interactions, establishing quetzalcoatlite as a distinctive realization of chiral magnetism on a perfect kagome lattice. At the same time, the small energy scale of the exchange interactions places the material close to competing magnetic regimes, suggesting that moderate pressure, chemical substitution, or structural modifications may strongly enhance frustration, suppress long-range order, and potentially drive the system toward a quantum spin-liquid state.

AI.tldr: 本文对天然矿物quetzalcoatlite（一种结构完美的kagome磁性材料）进行了首次全面的第一性原理研究，揭示了其电子结构由局域的Cu d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导，通过电子关联形成绝缘体；低能物理映射为Heisenberg模型后发现两种主要交换相互作用竞争，稳定了一种非常规的三维手性磁态——每层kagome呈现√3×√3有序，相邻层旋转60°，沿c轴形成右手螺旋。由于交换相互作用的能量尺度较小，该材料接近竞争磁态边界，可能通过压力、化学取代或结构修饰增强阻挫，抑制长程有序，进而驱动系统进入量子自旋液体态。
AI.motivation: kagome晶格上的几何阻挫、手性磁性及可调控性之间的相互作用是凝聚态物理的重要前沿问题。Quetzalcoatlite作为一种结构理想的kagome磁性材料，且不含无序，为研究这些物理提供了天然的纯净平台。然而此前缺乏对其电子和磁性性质的系统研究，因此作者开展了全面的第一性原理研究。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理（ab initio）计算方法，包括电子结构计算（DFT+U等）以刻画电子关联效应，识别局域化半填充的Cu d_{x^2-y^2}轨道；将低能物理映射到Heisenberg自旋模型，提取最近邻层内kagome耦合和次近邻层间耦合两种主要交换相互作用，分析竞争机制及其对三维磁性基态的稳定作用。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 电子结构由局域化的半填充Cu d_{x^2-y^2}轨道主导，在电子关联作用下成为绝缘体；(2) 磁性由最近邻层内kagome耦合和次近邻层间耦合两种交换相互作用竞争主导；(3) 该竞争稳定了非常规的三维手性磁有序态：每层为√3×√3有序，相邻层旋转60°，沿c轴形成右手螺旋；(4) 由于交换能量尺度较小，材料接近竞争磁态边界，具有调控潜力。
AI.conclusion: Quetzalcoatlite是完美kagome晶格上手性磁性的一种独特实现，其手性有序自然地从晶体结构和磁相互作用中涌现。更重要的是，其较低的能量尺度使其接近阻挫与长程有序的竞争边界，这为通过压力、化学取代或结构修饰来增强阻挫、抑制长程磁序并可能诱导量子自旋液体态提供了明确的可能性。

title: Spectrally local geometric response at the onset of many-body quantum chaos
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Includes Supplementary Material (6 pages + 3 figures). We welcome comments and suggestions
summary: We introduce the spectral density of geometric response, a measure of eigenstate sensitivity across an energy spectrum. Applied to many-body quantum systems, it reveals an exponentially sensitive integrability-to-chaos crossover, where eigenbasis deformations first accumulate in localized spectral regions before spreading throughout the spectrum. Physically motivated random-matrix ensembles reproduce this behaviour, whereas Gaussian ensembles do not, indicating universal features of the route to chaos that are absent from featureless random-matrix models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"几何响应的谱密度"这一度量，用于衡量本征态在整个能谱上的敏感性。将其应用于多体量子系统时，揭示了一个指数敏感的"可积到混沌"的过渡现象：本征基变形首先在局域谱区域累积，随后才扩散到整个能谱。基于物理动机的随机矩阵系综能再现此行为，而高斯系综则不能，表明通往混沌的路径具有普遍特征，而这些特征无法在无特征结构的随机矩阵模型中体现。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解多体量子系统从可积性到混沌的转变过程。传统随机矩阵模型（如高斯系综）虽然能描述混沌特征，但缺乏对"过渡路径"的刻画。作者希望寻找一个能揭示能谱上本征态敏感性分布的度量，以捕捉通往混沌过程中的普遍但非平凡的中间特征。
AI.method: 引入了"几何响应的谱密度"这一新度量，用于量化每个能量本征态对扰动的敏感程度。将该度量应用于多体量子系统，并比较了两种随机矩阵系综：物理动机驱动的系综（能重现可积-混沌过渡行为）和高斯系综（无特征结构）。通过对比分析谱密度在能谱上的分布与演化趋势来揭示过渡机制。
AI.result: 发现可积性到混沌的过渡具有指数敏感性，且本征基的变形先在局部谱区域累积，再逐渐扩散至整个能谱。物理动机的随机矩阵系综可以重现此过程，而高斯系综无法捕捉这一行为，表明通往混沌的路线的普遍特征超越了简单的无特征随机矩阵描述。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应的谱密度是一个有效的诊断工具，能够揭示从可积到混沌过渡的精细结构。该过渡的普遍特征（局域累积到全局扩散的模式）不能用高斯型随机矩阵模型捕捉，需要在随机矩阵框架中融入物理内容，从而扩展了对量子混沌过渡普遍性的理解。

title: Variational Parameter Calibration with Physics-Aware Latent-Space Surrogates
summary: Forward and inverse modeling of parametric dynamical systems requires surrogate models that are not only accurate for state prediction, but also informative for parameter calibration. However, a systematic end-to-end differentiable formulation for coupling deep-learning-based reduced-order surrogates with variational parameter estimation remains underdeveloped. In this work, we introduce a physics-aware neural-network-based latent-space framework for reduced-order forward modeling and variational parameter estimation. The proposed autoencoder-based approach yields a differentiable surrogate that maps physical parameters to predicted flow fields through a latent representation. The observable supervision is used during offline training to encourage the latent variables to retain information correlated with system parameters, while the online inverse problem is solved in the parameter space through the surrogate-induced observation operator. The method is evaluated on two computational-fluid-dynamics benchmarks. The results show that reconstruction accuracy alone is insufficient for inverse modeling, owing to the lack of end-to-end differentiability or physics awareness for variational parameter calibration. Quantitative latent-space analysis further shows that observable supervision improves case-level separability and temporal organization of latent representations. Experiments with realistic measurement settings, including noisy, low-resolution, randomly masked, and block-wise partial observations, demonstrate the robustness of the proposed framework and show that it generally reduces calibration error and variability compared with the standard surrogate models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理感知神经网络的潜空间框架，用于降阶前向建模和变分参数估计。通过自编码器构建可微分的代理模型，将物理参数映射到预测流场；离线训练时利用观测监督使潜变量保留与系统参数相关的信息，在线求解逆问题时在参数空间中通过代理诱导的观测算子进行变分校准。在两个CFD基准上的实验表明，仅靠重建精度不足以支持逆建模，观测监督改善了潜变量的可分性和时间组织，且在噪声、低分辨率、随机掩蔽和块状部分观测等现实测量条件下，所提框架相比标准代理模型普遍降低了校准误差和变异性。
AI.motivation: 参数动力系统的前向与逆建模需要代理模型既具备准确的态预测能力，又能为参数校准提供信息。然而，目前缺乏一种系统性的端到端可微分公式，将基于深度学习的降阶代理模型与变分参数估计耦合起来。现有方法的重建精度虽高，但缺乏端到端可微分性或物理感知能力，难以有效支持变分参数校准。
AI.method: 提出物理感知的基于自编码器的潜空间框架：(1) 可微分代理模型将物理参数通过潜表示映射到预测流场；(2) 离线训练中使用观测监督约束潜变量以保留与系统参数相关的信息；(3) 在线逆问题通过在参数空间中利用代理诱导的观测算子进行变分求解。
AI.result: 在两个CFD基准上验证：重建精度单独不足以用于逆建模；量化潜空间分析表明观测监督提升了案例级可分性和潜表示的时间组织性；在噪声、低分辨率、随机掩蔽和块状部分观测等现实测量设置下，框架表现出鲁棒性，且相比标准代理模型普遍降低校准误差和变异性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的物理感知神经潜空间框架能够同时支持准确的降阶前向预测和有效的信息化变分参数估计，弥补了纯重建式代理模型在逆建模中的不足，是一种系统性的端到端可微分耦合方案。

title: Transit Destination Inference from Tap-In-Only Bus Smart-Card Data: A Hierarchical Bayesian Approach
summary: Entry-only automatic fare collection systems record boardings but not alightings, preventing direct construction of origin-destination (OD) matrices. This study develops a Hierarchical Bayesian Latent-Destination (HBLD) model that combines station-hour boarding and inferred alighting demand with passenger card histories. Trip-chain destinations are treated as noisy evidence with a reliability parameter, allowing destination uncertainty to propagate into OD flows. The model was applied to 838,305 bus tap-ins collected in Changzhou in May 2025 and linked to stop-network and hourly weather data. It estimates destination distributions over feasible downstream and reverse-direction through-terminal stops using network, time-of-day, weather, and smoothed historical demand effects. A Bayesian personalization layer uses prior card trips and reverts to the shared trip-level distribution when history is unavailable. Fitted by stochastic variational inference and evaluated on the final week, HBLD outperformed the strongest baseline. Observed boarding patterns consistently improved prediction, especially without card history, while inferred alighting patterns helped only when trip-chain evidence was strongly trusted. The model captured travel consistent with through-terminal riding and bus-assisted road crossing and estimated destinations for trips unresolved by deterministic chaining. Because true alightings were unavailable, scores measure agreement with trip-chain outputs rather than actual destination accuracy. HBLD provides uncertainty-aware destination predictions and OD matrices for service management, planning, scheduling, and resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种层次贝叶斯潜在目的地（HBLD）模型，用于在仅记录上车（无下车）的自动收费系统中推断乘客目的地并构建OD矩阵。模型结合站点小时上车量、推断的下车需求及乘客刷卡历史，将出行链目的地视为带可靠性参数的噪声证据。在常州2025年5月的838,305条公交刷卡数据上验证，HBLD优于最强基线模型，提供了具有不确定性的目的地预测和OD矩阵。
AI.motivation: 仅上车式自动收费系统（entry-only AFC）只记录上车不记录下车，导致无法直接构建起讫点（OD）矩阵。现有的确定性出行链方法无法解决链断裂或缺乏历史数据的情况，且无法量化目的地预测的不确定性。
AI.method: 构建层次贝叶斯潜在目的地（HBLD）模型：(1) 将出行链目的地作为带可靠性参数的噪声证据；(2) 利用网络、时段、天气及平滑历史需求效应估计可行下游站点及反向过终点站的目的地分布；(3) 加入贝叶斯个性化层，使用历史刷卡记录，无历史时回退到共享出行级分布；(4) 通过随机变分推断拟合模型。
AI.result: 模型在最后一周测试集上优于最强基线。观测到的上车模式持续改善预测（尤其无历史卡片时）；推断的下车模式仅在出行链证据高度可信时有效。模型能捕捉过终点站乘车和公交辅助穿越道路的出行行为，并为确定性出行链无法解析的出行估计目的地。
AI.conclusion: HBLD提供了不确定性感知的目的地预测和OD矩阵，可服务于公交运营管理、规划、排班和资源配置。需要注意的是，由于真实下车数据不可得，评估得分反映的是与出行链输出的一致性而非真实目的地准确性。

title: Operational identifiability of false-vacuum decay rates in the quantum Ising chain
summary: Extracting a thermodynamic nucleation rate from finite-time quantum dynamics requires separating observable decay from estimator and finite-size validity. We develop a multilevel identification framework to real-time tensor-network simulations of false-vacuum decay in the one-dimensional quantum Ising chain. Across twelve parameter points with non-empty analysis intervals, the same coherent two-kink amplitudes semi-quantitatively predict both infinite-chain survival and magnetization dynamics: the survival coefficient has a median lattice-to-theory ratio of 0.902, while the magnetization-area slope ratios span 0.809--0.953. By contrast, the microscopic nearest-neighbour bond response is coherence dominated: vacuum--pair coherence contributes 60.0--81.5\% within the seven parameter points satisfying the matched-bond-dimension convergence criterion, while substantial late-window slope discrepancies remain that cannot be removed by a scalar normalization. The framework establishes reliable finite-time decay coefficients and identifies the additional finite-size and branch-validation requirements for a bulk thermodynamic rate interpretation. Within the two-kink model, a lattice-resolved WKB action reduces the median fixed-prefactor discrepancy with the coherent-bubble spectral calculation to 4.13\%. Quantitative cross-level consistency, observable-dependent reduced-model error, and a thermodynamic-rate interpretation that remains subject to finite-size validation can therefore coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多层次识别框架，应用于一维量子Ising链中假真空衰变的实时张量网络模拟。该框架通过相干双扭结幅度在半定量上预测无限链存活和磁化动力学，建立了可靠的有限时间衰变系数，并揭示了体热力学衰变速率解释所需的额外有限大小和分支验证要求。
AI.motivation: 从有限时间的量子动力学中提取热力学成核速率，需要将可观测的衰减与估计器和有限大小有效性分开。此前的挑战在于如何区分真实物理衰减信号与数值估计器误差及有限尺寸效应，从而获得可靠的体热力学衰变速率。
AI.method: 开发了多层次识别框架，应用于一维量子Ising链中假真空衰变的实时张量网络模拟。框架涵盖：(1) 跨12个参数点的无限链存活和磁化动力学分析；(2) 相干双扭结幅度模型用于预测衰变；（3）微观最近邻键响应一致性分析；（4）格点分辨WKB作用量与相干气泡谱计算的对比校验。
AI.result: 存活系数中位格点-理论比为0.902，磁化面积斜率比范围为0.809-0.953。真空-对相干性在满足匹配键维数收敛准则的7个参数点中贡献60.0-81.5%。格点分辨WKB作用将固定前置因子偏差中位数降至4.13%。
AI.conclusion: 跨层次定量一致性、可观测依赖的简化模型误差以及仍需有限大小验证的热力学速率解释可以共存。该框架建立了可靠的有限时间衰变系数，同时明确了体热力学速率解释需要额外的有限大小和分支验证要求。

title: The Fate of Crystalline Topological Phenomena in the Continuum
summary: The continuum limit is a widely used theoretical construct for obtaining continuum field-theories of crystalline systems. We study the formulation of a continuum limit for gapped bosonic phases and ask whether their topological properties survive passage to the continuum. Using methods in algebraic topology and category theory, we give a rigorous formulation of the continuum limit and construct a surjective global map relating crystalline topological phases across all finite point-group symmetries to continuum invertible topological phases. Consequently, we find that some lattice phases admit no continuum limit, while distinct lattice phases that do admit a continuum limit can share the same continuum image, hence implying that some lattice topological data can collapse. Conversely, we find that every continuum invertible phase admits a faithful crystalline realization. In addition to the general framework, we apply it to several examples, including studies of a 2D rotation-symmetric phase, higher-order topological phases, and the mixed spin-lattice anomaly of the deconfined quantum critical point between an antiferromagnet and valence bond solid.

AI.tldr: 本文利用代数拓扑和范畴论的方法，为带隙玻色子相的连续极限提供了严格的数学表述，构建了一个从所有有限点群对称性下的晶体拓扑相到连续体可逆拓扑相的满射全局映射，发现部分晶格相无连续极限、部分拓扑数据会坍缩，同时每个连续体可逆相都有忠实的晶体实现。
AI.motivation: 连续极限是获得晶体系统连续场论的标准理论构造，但长期以来缺乏严格的数学基础。作者希望回答一个核心问题：带隙玻色子相的拓扑性质在过渡到连续体时能否被保留，以及哪些晶格拓扑信息在连续化过程中会丢失。
AI.method: 作者利用代数拓扑和范畴论的严格工具来形式化连续极限这一理论构造，构建了一个从一个更大的分类（覆盖所有有限点群对称性的晶体拓扑相）到连续体可逆拓扑相的全局满射映射。该框架随后被应用于多个具体物理实例进行验证。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 部分晶格相不存在连续极限；(2) 不同的晶格相若存在连续极限，可能映射到相同的连续体图像，表明部分晶格拓扑数据会坍缩；(3) 每个连续体可逆相都能找到忠实的晶体实现。论文还应用该框架分析了二维旋转对称相、高阶拓扑相，以及反铁磁体-价键固体退禁闭量子临界点的混合自旋-晶格反常。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为晶体拓扑相与连续体拓扑相之间的关系提供了严格的数学框架，揭示了连续极限过程中拓扑信息的坍缩与保留规律，并展示了该框架在具体物理系统（包括高阶拓扑相和量子临界点反常）中的实用性。

title: Spin-coherent quantum designs
summary: Coherent states bridge the gap between quantum and classical physics, but their overcomplete and nonorthogonal nature makes it difficult to identify the minimal discrete set needed to reconstruct quantum information. Finite spin-coherent tomography and discrete coherent-state operator bases are known, but here we address the more specific rank-resolved problem of preserving the canonical contravariant-symbol representation. We show that the canonical finite coherent-state formula reconstructs every operator in the rank-$S$ sector exactly if and only if the sampling points form a spherical $(2J+S)$-design. We call the associated configurations spin-coherent quantum designs. We further give a fully explicit positive-weight Gauss-Legendre construction that avoids the need for an equal-weight spherical design. Together, these results establish a unified framework for reading out physical observables from a handful of measurement samples, playing for spin systems the role that the so-called von Neumann lattice plays for canonical coherent states. Finally, we derive practical protocols for estimating moments of spin operators from these constructions, with direct applications to polarimetry, magnetometry, and quantum state tomography.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限自旋相干态层析成像中秩分辨问题，证明了在秩为S的算子扇区内精确重构所有算子的充要条件是采样点构成球面(2J+S)设计，并提出了无需等权重球面设计的Gauss-Legendre正权重显式构造方法，建立了自旋系统的统一读出框架（类比von Neumann格），并推导了自旋算子矩估计的实际协议。
AI.motivation: 相干态在量子与经典物理之间架起桥梁，但其超完备性和非正交性使得确定重构量子信息所需的最小离散点集变得困难。已有研究建立了有限自旋相干态层析和离散相干态算子基，但对于保持正则协变符号表示的秩分辨问题尚未有明确答案，因此需要建立精确的重构条件与实用的构造方法。
AI.method: 通过数学分析证明有限相干态公式在秩S扇区精确重构的充要条件为采样点构成球面(2J+S)设计；提出一种完全显式、正权重的Gauss-Legendre构造方法，避免了对等权重球面设计的需求；由此定义自旋相干量子设计，并据此推导出自旋算子矩估计的实用测量协议。
AI.result: 建立了自旋相干量子设计的概念与理论框架，证明了秩分辨重构的充要条件，给出了无需等权重球面设计的Gauss-Legendre正权重构造方案，并推导了可用于偏振测量、磁强计和量子态层析的自旋算子矩估计协议。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为自旋系统从少量测量样本中读出物理可观测量提供了统一的数学框架，对应于正则相干态的von Neumann格在自旋系统中的作用，为实用量子测量与估计提供了理论基础。

title: Improved quantum sampling methods for molecular simulations
summary: Quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI) methods use a quantum computer to identify dominant electronic configurations in the molecular ground state, while a classical computer diagonalizes the Hamiltonian within the reduced subspace spanned by those configurations. Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), a leading QSCI approach, uses iterative classical post-processing to correct noisy quantum measurement to ensure that the corresponding configurations remain physically sensible. In this work, we show that SQD performance can be strongly influenced by uncontrolled growth of the classical diagonalization subspace. When classical resources are not explicitly constrained, classical uniform random sampling can reproduce SQD benchmarks as noise increases the diversity of sampled configurations. We show any fair benchmarking protocol of SQD must explicitly control diagonalization size over unique samples. We then address the problem of efficiently discovering physically relevant, energy-lowering configurations by introducing a measurement protocol based on non-orthogonal configuration interaction (NOCI). By distributing measurements across orbital bases optimized with respect to the molecular Hamiltonian, we obtain improved sample efficiency relative to measurements performed solely in the Hartree--Fock basis. Importantly, these improvements persist even under fixed classical resource budgets, demonstrating that the resulting configurations are of higher quality rather than being more numerous. Under our proposed benchmarking procedure, we establish measurement-basis engineering as a promising route to improving quantum sampling methods for electronic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法在基准测试中存在的关键缺陷：当经典对角化子空间不受控增长时，经典均匀随机采样即可复现SQD的性能，因此任何公平的SQD基准测试都必须显式控制唯一样本上的对角化规模。此外，作者提出了一种基于非正交组态相互作用（NOCI）的测量协议，通过在不同轨道基之间分配测量，在固定经典资源预算下仍能提高采样效率，表明测量基工程是改进量子电子结构采样方法的有前途的途径。
AI.motivation: 量子选择的组态相互作用（QSCI）方法利用量子计算机识别分子基态中的主导电子组态，再由经典计算机在降维子空间中对角化哈密顿量。SQD作为领先的QSCI方法，其性能可能受到经典对角化子空间失控增长的强烈影响，这会导致基准测试结果的误导性。因此需要明确任何公平的基准测试协议必须控制对角化规模，并探索更高效发现物理相关、降低能量组态的方法。
AI.method: 作者首先通过理论分析与模拟证明，当经典资源不受约束时，经典均匀随机采样可以在噪声增加导致采样组态多样性上升时复现SQD的基准结果，从而揭示子空间增长的伪优势。然后提出基于NOCI的测量协议：将测量分配到针对分子哈密顿量优化的不同轨道基上，而非仅在Hartree-Fock基中进行测量，以提高配置发现的采样效率。
AI.result: 在固定经典资源预算下，基于NOCI的多轨道基测量方案相比仅在Hartree-Fock基中测量，获得了更高的采样效率。由于改进在固定资源预算下仍然持续存在，表明所发现的组态质量更高而非数量更多。该结果在作者提出的受控基准测试程序下得到验证。
AI.conclusion: SQD等QSCI方法的基准测试必须显式控制经典对角化子空间的大小（基于唯一样本数），否则经典随机采样即可达到相同甚至更好的性能，使量子优势被高估。测量基工程（如基于NOCI的多基分布测量）是提升量子采样电子结构方法性能的有效且可扩展的策略。

title: Spectral graph clustering with inhomogeneous latent geometry
summary: We study spectral clustering in the presence of a confounding latent geometry. The leading eigenvectors may then be dominated by the latent geometry rather than by the communities. Nevertheless, we show in a block latent-space model that communities can be recovered from eigenvectors deeper in the spectrum. We analyze the spectral properties of the adjacency matrix through a limiting integral operator and use its structure to develop DBSPEC, a density-based spectral clustering algorithm that requires only approximate localization of the informative eigenvalue and is robust to poor eigenvalue separation. Crucially, this approach handles general latent geometries, overcoming restrictions to homogeneous toroidal models in prior works. Our theoretical predictions for the location of the informative eigenvalue notably align with observations in real-world experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究存在混杂潜在几何结构时的谱聚类问题。在块潜在空间模型中，虽然领先特征向量可能被潜在几何主导而掩盖社区结构，但社区仍可从更深层的特征向量中恢复。作者提出DBSPEC算法，一种基于密度的谱聚类方法，只需近似定位信息特征值即可工作，对特征值分离度差具有鲁棒性，且能处理一般的潜在几何结构（超越以往局限于均匀环面模型的限制）。
AI.motivation: 在存在混杂潜在几何结构（latent geometry）的网络中，标准谱聚类使用的领先特征向量会被潜在几何主导，导致社区结构无法被发现。以往方法受限于均匀环面等特殊几何模型，缺乏对一般潜在几何结构的处理方法。
AI.method: 作者在块潜在空间模型（block latent-space model）框架下，通过极限积分算子分析邻接矩阵的谱性质，利用其特征结构定位信息特征值，并提出DBSPEC——一种基于密度的谱聚类算法。该算法仅需对信息特征值进行近似定位，对特征值分离不佳的情形依然鲁棒。
AI.result: 理论预测的信息特征值位置与真实世界实验观测结果显著一致，表明该方法在实际数据上有效。DBSPEC克服了以往方法对均匀环面模型的限制，可处理一般潜在几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 在潜在几何干扰下，社区信息存在于谱的更深层特征向量中；通过极限积分算子理论分析邻接矩阵谱结构并采用基于密度的聚类策略，可以在一般潜在几何条件下有效恢复社区结构，且算法对特征值分离质量要求宽松。

title: A piston-like polymer stochastic heat engine
summary: Colloidal stochastic engines are often regarded as microscopic analogues of macroscopic pis ton cylinder heat engines. However, although they share some underlying physical principles, such systems remain far from being direct force generators from a practical perspective. Motivated by this limitation, the present study introduces a polymer-based stochastic engine that more closely mimics the operation of piston cylinder engines. In this setup, heat is converted into work through a cyclic process in which a polymer is pulled into and out of a narrow channel under varying tem peratures. The work performed by the engine can be directly obtained from the cyclic trajectory in the force position diagram, analogous to the pressure volume diagram in traditional heat engines. Despite its much higher number of degrees of freedom compared to colloidal engines, the polymer en gine nevertheless follows several characteristic features observed in such systems. Numerical results demonstrate consistency with universal low-dissipation bounds for e ciency, recovery of Carnot e ciency under regeneration, and low-dissipation scaling of work and power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于聚合物的随机热引擎，该引擎通过温度变化下将聚合物拉入和拉出窄通道的循环过程将热转化为功，其力-位置图类似于传统热机的压力-体积图。数值结果表明该引擎满足通用低耗散效率边界、再生条件下恢复卡诺效率，以及功和功率的低耗散标度律。
AI.motivation: 胶体随机引擎虽被视为宏观活塞-气缸热机的微观类似物，但缺乏实际直接力产生的实用性。本文旨在设计一种更接近活塞-气缸引擎工作方式的聚合物基随机引擎以克服此局限。
AI.method: 构建聚合物基随机引擎：在温度循环变化的条件下，将聚合物牵引进入和拉出窄通道，形成循环做功过程。通过力-位置图（类比压力-体积图）从循环轨迹直接计算引擎所做的功，并与胶体引擎的特征进行对比分析。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：尽管聚合物引擎比胶体引擎具有更高的自由度，但仍表现出胶体系统的若干特征，包括与通用低耗散边界一致的效率、再生条件下恢复卡诺效率，以及功和功率的低耗散标度关系。
AI.conclusion: 聚合物基随机引擎提供了更接近宏观活塞-气缸热机的工作模式，同时保持了随机热引擎的普适热力学特征，为微观热引擎的实际力产生应用提供了新途径。

title: Thermodynamic Spectroscopy of Emergent Excitations in Quantum Spin Ice
comment: Main text: 7 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental material: 16 pages, 3 figures
summary: Quantum spin ice (QSI) is a three-dimensional quantum spin liquid where fractionalized spinons interact with emergent photons. The XXZ model on the pyrochlore lattice realizes such a $U(1)$ quantum spin liquid and a number of pyrochlore magnets have been investigated as candidate materials, but the detection of emergent excitations has been a major challenge. The specific heat is expected to show the higher-energy spinon excitations and a lower-energy anomaly at the ring-exchange scale, which sets both the photon bandwidth and the energy of the emergent magnetic monopoles (or visons). In reality, the lower-energy peak is obscured by the nuclear Schottky anomaly in non-Kramers Pr-based systems, while it is not clearly resolved from the spinon contributions in Ce-based dipolar-octupolar systems. In this work, we propose a novel thermodynamic probe of the elusive ring-exchange energy scale. We show that in the presence of a weak perturbation coupled to the transverse component of the pseudospin degrees of freedom, the temperature derivative of an observable conjugate to such a weak perturbing force is highly sensitive to the ring-exchange energy scale. Using this scheme, it is shown that the difference between thermal expansion coefficients along the [100] and [010] directions should show a peak at the ring-exchange energy scale for non-Kramers QSI. Similarly, the temperature derivative of the magnetization, $dM/dT$, of dipolar-octupolar pyrochlores under a weak magnetic field can also detect the same signal. Moreover, the sign of these signatures distinguishes the zero-flux and $π$-flux QSI states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的热力学探针来探测量子自旋冰中难以捉摸的环交换能标。通过对横向赝自旋分量的弱微扰，测量与该微扰共轭的可观测量对温度的导数，可以灵敏地探测环交换能标。具体提出沿[100]和[010]方向热膨胀系数之差在非Kramers体系中呈现峰，以及dM/dT在偶极-八极镨酸盐体系中探测同一信号，且信号符号可区分零通量和π通量态。
AI.motivation: 量子自旋冰中的环交换能标同时决定光子带宽和涌现磁单极子能量，但现有探测手段面临困难：非Kramers的Pr基体系中该峰被核Schottky异常掩盖，Ce基偶极-八极体系中又与自旋子贡献难以区分。因此需要一种新的可靠热力学探针来检测这一关键能标。
AI.method: 作者提出在弱微扰场与赝自旋横向分量耦合的背景下，测量与该微扰共轭的可观测量对温度的导数（如热膨胀系数之差或dM/dT）。该导数对环交换能标高度敏感，因为其响应反映了与微扰相关的能量涨落特征。符号分析可区分零通量和π通量量子自旋冰态。
AI.result: 证明[100]与[010]方向热膨胀系数之差在非Kramers量子自旋冰中会在环交换能标处呈现峰；偶极-八极体系中的dM/dT在弱磁场下也可检测同一能标；这些信号的符号能区分零通量和π通量量子自旋冰态。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为探测磁性材料中难以观察的环交换能标提供了一种新的热力学探针，可作为比热测量之外的补充手段，并且能通过符号辨别区分不同通量构型的量子自旋冰态。

title: Teleportation through time-varying channels: threshold geometry and a complete-positivity bound on non-Markovian backflow
summary: A Bell pair distributed through a link that combines amplitude damping with dephasing at time-dependent rates has dynamics that separate into a fixed part and a moving one. The negativity, fully entangled fraction, discord, and average teleportation fidelity depend on time only through the accumulated damping parameters $p(t)$ and $q(t)$. Every threshold is therefore a curve fixed in the unit square, and the rates select nothing but a trajectory across it. The Horodecki fidelity formula $\bar{F} = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{6}\mathrm{Tr}|T|$ covers one- and two-sided exposure alike: the condition $\det T \leq 0$ under which it takes this form holds throughout the unit square for both. Under symmetric two-sided noise the entanglement vanishes when $p+q\geq1$, where the exact relation $\bar{F}^{2s}=\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\mathcal{N}_{2s}$ ties disentanglement and the loss of quantum advantage to the same instant. One-sided exposure admits no finite-time sudden death for any rate profile, and the discord stays strictly positive throughout the open square, so the distributed state can be separable, useless for teleportation, and still nonclassical. For harmonically modulated rates, complete positivity caps the backflow at one modulation period of static decay, $ΔΓ_{k}\leq2πγ_{k,0}/Ω$, equivalently at a modulation depth $ξ_{k}\leq4.6033$ independent of $Ω$. Inside that window the trajectory reverses, producing finite intervals of restored quantum advantage and entanglement sudden birth.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Bell对在兼具振幅阻尼和退相且速率随时间变化的信道中的动力学行为。研究显示所有量子度量（负性、全纠缠分数、量子失协、平均隐形传态保真度）仅通过累积阻尼参数p(t)和q(t)依赖时间，因此所有阈值都是单位正方形中的固定曲线，速率仅决定穿越轨迹。对称双侧噪声下纠缠消失条件为p+q≥1，且存在精确关系F̄^{2s}=2/3+1/3N_{2s}；单侧暴露无有限时间猝死，量子失协在整个开正方形内严格为正。对于谐波调制速率，完全正性将回流量限制在一个静态衰减调制周期内，并存在与Ω无关的调制深度上限ξ_k≤4.6033，在此窗口内可恢复量子优势并产生纠缠突然诞生。
AI.motivation: 理解开放量子系统中纠缠和量子关联的动力学对于量子信息处理至关重要。现有研究多关注静态或简单时变噪声，但实际场景中噪声速率通常是时间依赖的。作者旨在统一描述振幅阻尼与退相混合信道下Bell对的量子关联演化，并阐明噪声速率调制对量子优势恢复和纠缠突然死亡的深层影响。
AI.method: 作者利用时变速率信道中Bell对的动力学可分性，将问题映射到由累积阻尼参数p(t)和q(t)组成的单位正方形参数空间。通过计算负性、全纠缠分数、量子失协和平均隐形传态保真度，建立各度量随累积参数的显式阈值曲线。对于谐波调制速率，结合完全正性条件推导回流上限，并分析状态轨迹的几何反转行为。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 所有量子度量仅通过累积参数p,q依赖时间，阈值均为单位正方形中的固定曲线；(2) Horodecki保真度公式F̄=1/2+1/6Tr|T|在单侧和双侧噪声下均成立，且det T≤0在全正方形内成立；(3) 对称双侧噪声下纠缠消失条件为p+q≥1，并有精确关系F̄^{2s}=2/3+1/3N_{2s}将纠缠消失与量子优势丧失绑定在同一时刻；(4) 单侧暴露无有限时间猝死，量子失协始终为正，状态可分离但非经典；(5) 谐波调制下完全正性给出回流量上限ΔΓ_k≤2πγ_{k,0}/Ω，对应调制深度ξ_k≤4.6033且与Ω无关，窗口内可恢复量子优势并产生纠缠突然诞生。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过参数化累积阻尼效应，提供了一种统一框架来理解复杂时变噪声信道中的量子关联演化。揭示了速率调制可诱导量子优势的周期性恢复与纠缠突然诞生现象，并给出完全正性约束下的精确边界条件。这为设计可在非马尔可夫噪声环境中操作的实际量子通信协议提供了理论指导。

title: RECAST: A Machine-Learning Framework for Correction and Super-Resolution of Coarse-Grid PDE Solvers
summary: Coarse-grid numerical solvers can substantially reduce the computational cost of time-dependent PDE simulation, but under-resolution often degrades both the trajectory and the spatial fidelity of the solution. We introduce RECAST (Recurrent Error Correction And Super-resolution of coarse-grid Trajectories), a machine-learning framework designed to restore this lost accuracy while retaining coarse-grid evolution. RECAST combines learned correction within the numerical time-stepping loop with reconstruction of the corresponding fine-grid state from the corrected coarse history. We evaluate the framework on six one-dimensional PDE systems spanning transport, diffusion, dispersion, reaction, and wave dynamics, using spatial grids coarsened by factors of 8-16 and 1000-step closed-loop rollouts from unseen initial conditions. Across the test cases, RECAST remains closely aligned with the fine-grid reference solutions and reduces time-averaged relative error by approximately 50-92% compared with the corresponding uncorrected coarse-grid solvers. Additional tests show generalization to unseen PDE parameter values, while comparison with a contemporary coarse-correction architecture shows that RECAST achieves lower error and better long-horizon agreement with the fine-grid reference over 5000-step rollouts. These results demonstrate that the learned correction and reconstruction capabilities of RECAST can enable substantially coarser PDE evolution without the corresponding loss of solution fidelity, providing a proof-of-concept route toward machine-learning acceleration of higher-dimensional numerical simulations across science and engineering.

AI.tldr: RECAST是一个机器学习框架，通过在学习到的数值时间步进循环内进行误差校正，并从校正后的粗网格历史重建细网格状态，从而在保持粗网格演化效率的同时恢复PDE仿真的时空精度。在6个一维PDE系统上，经过8-16倍网格粗化和1000步闭环滚动测试，RECAST将时间平均相对误差降低了约50-92%，并在5000步滚动中优于当代粗网格校正架构。
AI.motivation: 粗网格数值求解器可以大幅降低时变PDE仿真的计算成本，但欠分辨率通常同时降低轨迹精度和空间保真度。作者希望开发一种框架，在保留粗网格演化的计算优势的同时，恢复丢失的求解精度。
AI.method: RECAST框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 在数值时间步进循环内嵌入学习到的误差校正模块；(2) 从校正后的粗网格历史轨迹重建对应的细网格状态。两者协同工作，即先通过校正提升粗网格轨迹精度，再利用超分辨率重建恢复空间细节。
AI.result: 在6个一维PDE系统（涵盖输运、扩散、色散、反应和波动动力学）上，使用8-16倍空间网格粗化和1000步闭环滚动测试，RECAST与细网格参考解保持高度一致，将时间平均相对误差降低约50-92%。此外，该框架能够泛化到未见过的PDE参数值，并在5000步滚动测试中优于当代粗网格校正架构。
AI.conclusion: RECAST证明了学习式校正与重建能力可以使PDE演化在显著更粗的网格上进行而不损失求解保真度，为通过机器学习加速更高维数值仿真提供了概念验证路径。

title: Stability of Finite-Batch Particle Mean-Field Variational Inference Beyond Strong Convexity
summary:
We study the implementable finite-batch particle algorithm for mean-field variational inference as a fully discrete stochastic approximation of the projected Wasserstein dynamics. The target potential is globally smooth but need not be strongly convex. The departure from contractivity is quantified by the curvature defect \[ \mathfrak d_α(x,y) =
\bigl[α\|x-y\|^2- \langle\nabla V(x)-\nabla V(y),x-y\rangle\bigr]_+, \] which is the additive loss in the one-step Euler contraction estimate. We prove a non-asymptotic Wasserstein stability bound that separates initialization, product-empirical approximation, finite-batch drift error, time discretization, and the defects accumulated along the coupled trajectories. Under the uniform bound $\mathfrak d_α\leqβ$, the particle iterates remain within $O(\sqrt{β/α})$ of any MFVI minimizer, up to explicit errors in the particle number, batch size, and step size. The proof uses a stationary comparison array whose population law is an MFVI minimizer but whose particle-level law is a random product empirical measure, and it controls the resulting projected-drift discrepancy explicitly. We also give coordinatewise defect estimates and structural conditions for dimension-independent projected-drift sensitivity, construct an arbitrary-dimensional smooth nonconvex benchmark with a closed-form MFVI minimizer, and explain why polynomially growing drifts require a modification of the untamed explicit scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了均值场变分推断（MFVI）的可行有限批量粒子算法，将其视为投影Wasserstein动力学的全离散随机近似。在目标势能全局光滑但非强凸的设定下，通过曲率缺陷度量刻画偏离收缩性的程度，证明了非渐近Wasserstein稳定性界，该界分离了初始化、乘积经验近似、有限批量漂移误差、时间离散化以及耦合轨迹上的缺陷累积效应。粒子迭代保持在任意MFVI极小点的O(√(β/α))邻域内。
AI.motivation: 现有MFVI粒子算法的理论分析大多依赖于强凸性假设来保证收缩性，而实际应用中目标势能往往非强凸甚至非凸。作者旨在突破强凸限制，对非强凸势能下的有限批量粒子算法建立非渐近稳定性保证，量化各种误差来源的贡献。
AI.method: 1) 引入曲率缺陷d_α来衡量欧拉一步收缩估计中的加性损失，替代传统强凸性假设；2) 构造"平稳比较阵列"：其总体律为MFVI极小点，但粒子级律为随机乘积经验测度，从而显式控制投影漂移差异；3) 证明非渐近Wasserstein稳定性界，分离初始化误差、乘积经验近似误差、有限批量漂移误差、时间离散化和缺陷累积项；4) 利用坐标wise缺陷估计及结构条件分析实现维度无关的投影漂移敏感性；5) 构造任意维光滑非凸基准示例（具有闭式MFVI极小点），并分析多项式增长漂移为何需要对显式格式进行修改。
AI.result: 在均匀缺陷界d_α≤β下，粒子迭代保持在任意MFVI极小点的O(√(β/α))邻域内，误差项显式依赖于粒子数、批大小和步长。获得了坐标wise缺陷估计，给出了维度无关投影漂移敏感性的结构条件，并构造了具有闭式MFVI极小点的任意维光滑非凸基准。同时揭示了多项式增长漂移下原始显式格式失效的机理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非强凸MFVI场景提供了完整的非渐近稳定性理论框架，通过曲率缺陷将非收缩设定转化为可控的误差累积问题，为实际粒子算法提供了明确的精度保证，并指出了当前显式格式的局限性及改进方向。

title: Ideal heat engine cycles at maximal efficiency -- the ideal gas and beyond
summary: Given a particular heat engine cycle, what is the optimal working medium that results in the highest efficiency? While one might jump to the conclusion that it must surely be the ideal gas, the situation is actually more intricate. Starting with a general Hemlholtz potential that depends polynomially on molar volume and temperature we derive exact expressions for the ideal Stirling, Otto, and Brayton cycles. We find that quite universally the maximal efficiency is achieved for thermodynamics systems, whose working mediums are linear in temperature. This includes the ideal gas, but also classical harmonic oscillators and pheonmenological models of the rubber band.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在给定的热机循环（如Stirling、Otto和Brayton循环）中，何种工作介质能够实现最高效率。作者从一般的Helmholtz势出发，推导出理想循环的精确表达式，发现当工作介质的热力学性质对温度呈线性依赖时，效率达到最大；这包括理想气体、经典谐振子和橡皮带的唯象模型。
AI.motivation: 传统直觉认为理想气体是热机的"最佳"工作介质，但作者指出实际情况更为复杂。核心动机是想从理论上回答：对于给定的热机循环，哪种工作介质能获得最高效率？这一问题的答案对热力学设计与优化具有基础性意义。
AI.method: 作者从依赖于摩尔体积和温度的的一般Helmholtz势出发，推导了理想Stirling、Otto和Brayton循环的精确效率表达式。通过对这些表达式的系统分析，探究了在不同热力学系统（包括理想气体、经典谐振子、橡皮带唯象模型等）中效率的最大化条件。
AI.result: 研究发现，最大效率普遍由对温度呈线性依赖的热力学系统实现。这类系统不仅包括理想气体，还包括经典谐振子以及橡皮带的唯象模型，表明该结论具有相当的普适性，而非理想气体独享的特性。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出的结论是：最优工作介质并非唯一的理想气体，而是广义上"能量线性依赖于温度"的一类热力学系统。这一结论统摄了多种物理体系，为热机工作介质的选择提供了更一般的理论指导。

title: Light-induced effective magnetic fields in Landau quantized graphene
summary: Ultrafast magnetism triggered by circularly polarized radiation underpins ultrafast spin control, relevant to future technologies, e.g., opto-spintronics and magnonics. The dynamics are often complicated and intertwined among correlated subsystems, such as electrons, spins, phonons, plasmons, topology, and lattice, due to many-body quantum coupling at ultrafast timescales. Here, we demonstrate light-induced effective magnetic fields generated by selective excitation between non-equidistant Landau quantized states in graphene, a prototypical Dirac material, using circularly polarized pulses. By magnetically tuning the Landau-level transition resonance away from other low-energy excitations, we obtain a clean electrostatically controllable platform and identify the microscopic origin of the light-induced magnetic signals, independent of sublattice coupling. Because different Landau levels carry distinct optical Hall conductivities, direct modification of their occupancies via optical excitations creates transient Faraday rotation signals with dispersive magnetic-field dependence, mirroring the static magneto-optical lineshape. The induced effective magnetic field normalized by the pump electric field exceeds typical reported values for the inverse Faraday effect of electronic origin. Our results establish a clear microscopic picture of the inverse Faraday effect of electronic origin, which can trigger hierarchical dynamics among correlated sublattices once Landau-level transitions are magnetically tuned to coincide with other low-energy excitations in Dirac systems and related materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过圆偏振光选择性激发石墨烯中非等距朗道量子态之间的跃迁，演示了光诱导有效磁场的产生。通过磁调谐朗道能级跃迁共振使其远离其他低能激发，作者获得了干净的静电可控平台，并识别出光诱导磁信号的微观起源独立于亚晶格耦合。不同朗道能级具有不同的光学霍尔电导率，光学激发改变其占据数产生瞬态法拉第旋转信号。归一化后的诱导有效磁场超过文献报道的电子起源逆法拉第效应典型值，建立了电子起源逆法拉第效应的清晰微观图像。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振辐射触发的超快磁性是实现超快自旋控制的基础，对光自旋电子学和磁振子学等未来技术至关重要。然而，超快时间尺度上的多体量子耦合使电子、自旋、声子、等离子体激元、拓扑和晶格等关联子系统的动力学往往复杂且相互交织，难以厘清微观机制。作者希望在一个干净的平台上识别光诱导磁信号的微观起源。
AI.method: 以石墨烯（典型狄拉克材料）为平台，使用圆偏振脉冲选择性激发非等距朗道量子化态之间的跃迁。通过磁调谐朗道能级跃迁共振以远离其他低能激发，利用不同朗道能级携带不同光学霍尔电导率的特性，通过光学激发直接修改其占据数产生瞬态法拉第旋转信号，并测量其色散磁场的依赖关系。
AI.result: 获得了干净且静电可调控的平台，验证了光诱导磁信号独立于亚晶格耦合的微观起源。瞬态法拉第旋转信号呈现色散的磁场依赖关系，镜像了静态磁光谱线形。诱导有效磁场归一化到泵浦电场后，超过了文献报道的电子起源逆法拉第效应的典型值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了电子起源逆法拉第效应的清晰微观图像，并指出一旦朗道能级跃迁被磁调谐到与狄拉克系统及相关材料中其他低能激发重合，即可触发关联亚晶格间的层级动力学，为超快自旋操控提供理论基础。

title: Modelling quantum measurement dynamics: from decoherence to redundancy with site-hopping indistinguishable particles
summary: In recent years, new theoretical insights into decoherence and quantum measurements have emerged through the study of many-body dynamics in isolated quantum systems. It is now understood that the parameters and energy scales in system-environment interactions decisively affect how readily information spreads from a quantum system into its surroundings during a decoherence event. A popular choice for studying these effects is the framework of quantum Darwinism (QD), but so far few works have applied this to realistic many-body models. Inspired by experimentally-accessible setups, in this work we introduce a simple, flexible, numerically exact many-body model of a system broadcasting information into an environment: a 1D lattice of sites with hopping particles. We show that different choices of parameters lead to the recovery of known scenarios featuring different decoherence and QD effects, such as equilibration, revivals of coherence, and redundancy. In constructing this model we resolve the crucial issue of indistinguishability: we explain how to calculate the entropy of a fraction of the environment when said environment is composed of indistinguishable fermions or bosons (or lattice sites containing them). We then show that particle statistics can make a notable difference to the QD properties of the setup, with fermionic environments sometimes achieving redundancy much more readily than bosonic or site-based ones. Our work opens the door to much closer alignment between theoretical models and experimental tests of the dynamics of quantum measurements and the quantum-to-classical transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于1D格点跳跃粒子的数值精确多体模型来研究量子达尔文主义（QD）和退相干现象，解决了不可分辨粒子环境熵计算的关键问题，并发现费米子环境比玻色子或格点环境更容易实现冗余信息广播。
AI.motivation: 量子达尔文主义（QD）是研究退相干和量子测量中信息传播的重要框架，但以往很少有工作将其应用于现实的多体模型。作者希望引入一个与实验可及设置相关、简单灵活且数值精确的多体模型，来统一研究不同参数下的退相干、相干恢复和冗余等现象，并解决由不可分辨粒子（费米子/玻色子）组成环境时的熵计算这一关键问题。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个1D格点模型，格点上存在跳跃粒子作为环境，系统向环境广播信息。通过调整模型参数可以复现不同的退相干和QD场景（如平衡化、相干恢复和冗余）。关键创新在于：当环境由不可分辨的费米子或玻色子（或包含它们的格点）组成时，给出了计算环境子部分熵的明确方法，并在此框架下比较不同粒子统计性质对QD性质的影响。
AI.result: 不同参数选择可以恢复已知的多种退相干和QD场景。粒子统计性质对QD结果有显著影响：费米子环境有时比玻色子或格点环境更容易实现冗余（redundancy）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理论模型与实验测量之间建立更紧密的联系铺平了道路，有助于深入研究量子测量的动力学和量子到经典转变过程。

title: Spin lifetime anisotropy in graphene induced by the SiO2 interface
summary: Understanding how common dielectric substrates influence the spin transport properties of graphene is essential for advancing graphene-based spintronic technologies. Here we use a comprehensive set of numerical simulations to reveal how a SiO$_2$ substrate modifies the spin texture and governs spin relaxation in graphene. Using first-principles density matrix dynamics simulations, as well as tight-binding (TB) transport simulations, we quantify the effects of electron-phonon scattering, impurity scattering, and electrostatic disorder on the spin relaxation process. We find that a 2D SiO$_2$ substrate induces a predominantly Rashba-type helical spin texture in graphene, leading to a spin lifetime anisotropy of 1/2. Meanwhile, bulk SiO$_2$ breaks in-plane symmetry in graphene, leading to anisotropic in-plane and out-of-plane components in the spin texture, which we capture with a newly-developed TB model of graphene. Transport simulations under realistic disorder conditions reveal a spin lifetime anisotropy between 0.5 and 1, similar to what is seen in measurements of graphene spin valves on a SiO$_2$ substrate. Our results reveal a more complex picture of spin relaxation at the ubiquitous graphene/SiO$_2$ interface, beyond the standard Rashba model, providing critical insight for interpreting experiments and guiding substrate engineering for graphene spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理密度矩阵动力学模拟和紧束缚（TB）输运模拟，揭示了SiO₂衬底如何修饰石墨烯的自旋织构并主导其自旋弛豫过程。研究发现2D SiO₂衬底诱导石墨烯产生主导性的Rashba型螺旋自旋织构（自旋寿命各向异性为1/2），而体相SiO₂则破坏面内对称性，导致自旋织构出现各向异性的面内和面外分量。在现实无序条件下，输运模拟给出的自旋寿命各向异性介于0.5至1之间，与石墨烯/SiO₂自旋阀实验测量结果吻合。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯基自旋电子学器件中，SiO₂是最常用的介电衬底，但人们对SiO₂衬底如何影响石墨烯的自旋输运性质缺乏深入理解。现有模型（如标准Rashba模型）无法完整解释实验观测到的自旋弛豫行为，需要更全面的理论框架来揭示SiO₂对石墨烯自旋织构和自旋弛豫的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用两类互补的数值模拟方法：(1) 第一性原理密度矩阵动力学模拟，用于量化电子-声子散射、杂质散射和静电无序对自旋弛豫的影响；(2) 紧束缚（TB）输运模拟，其中开发了一个新型TB模型以捕捉体相SiO₂衬底导致的石墨烯面内对称性破缺效应。系统地比较了2D SiO₂与体相SiO₂两种衬底情形下的自旋织构和自旋寿命各向异性。
AI.result: 2D SiO₂衬底在石墨烯中诱导出以Rashba型为主的螺旋自旋织构，自旋寿命各向异性为1/2。体相SiO₂衬底则打破石墨烯的面内对称性，使自旋织构出现各向异性的面内和面外分量。在现实无序条件下，TB输运模拟得到的自旋寿命各向异性在0.5到1之间，与石墨烯/SiO₂自旋阀的实验测量值一致。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯/SiO₂界面处的自旋弛豫比标准Rashba模型所描述的更为复杂——需要同时考虑2D和体相衬底效应、多种散射机制以及静电无序的共同作用。该工作为解释实验数据提供了关键洞见，并可为石墨烯自旋电子学中的衬底工程提供理论指导。

title: A Quantum/Classical Example Oracle Separation for Making Things Up
summary: We study the power of quantum examples, as compared to classical examples, in the PAC learning framework. Here, we have two learning algorithms, both with access to quantum computation, but one gets quantum examples, whereas the other gets classical examples. It was previously unknown whether there were learning tasks that can be efficiently performed but not by the latter. Our primary result is to show that relative to an oracle, there are distributions that can be efficiently generated by a quantum learner with access to quantum examples, but not by a quantum learner with access to only classical examples, making progress to answering this question in the affirmative.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了PAC学习框架中量子样本相对于经典样本的优越性。作者证明在相对于一个预言机的条件下，存在某些分布可以被拥有量子样本的量子学习器高效生成，但无法被仅拥有经典样本的量子学习器高效生成，从而在肯定方向上回答了"是否存在量子样本比经典样本更具优势的学习任务"这一问题。
AI.motivation: 在PAC学习框架中，以往未知是否存在这样的学习任务：拥有量子样本的学习器可以高效完成，而仅拥有经典样本（但同样有量子计算能力）的学习器无法高效完成。回答这一问题有助于理解量子样本在机器学习中的本质优势。
AI.method: 通过构造一个相对论化的（oracle-based）分离证明，展示在某种预言机下，存在特定的分布使得量子样本学习者能够高效生成该分布，而经典样本学习者则无法做到。
AI.result: 在相对预言机的条件下，存在某些分布可被量子样本学习者高效生成，但不可被仅有经典样本的量子学习者高效生成，从而证明了量子样本相对于经典样本的分离性结果。
AI.conclusion: 该结果在相对化意义上肯定了"量子样本能够提供超出经典样本的学习优势"这一猜想，为量子机器学习提供了理论支持，并为进一步在无条件意义下探索量子样本的优越性奠定了基础。

title: Macroscopic fluctuation theory for the multi-time statistics of current in non-stationary diffusive systems
comment: 50 pages, 5 figures, JSTAT Special Issue StatPhys29
summary: The statistics of current fluctuations has long been a central object of study in non-equilibrium physics. Most existing work has focused on one-time statistics, while their multi-time generalisation remains comparatively less explored. We address this gap by extending the fluctuating hydrodynamics framework of Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory (MFT) to study multi-time statistics in the non-stationary state of a diffusive system on an infinite line. For the simplest cases of a non-interacting lattice gas and hard-core Brownian point particles, we present explicit solution of the MFT leading to multi-time large-deviation statistics. For generic systems, the MFT is solved perturbatively, yielding explicit results for two-time correlations. These reveal that the connection between current fluctuations and fractional Brownian motion, previously observed for flat initial conditions, does not persist for step initial conditions. We independently verify these hydrodynamic results by solving the corresponding microscopic dynamics for the non-interacting gas and for the symmetric simple exclusion process. Additional confirmation comes from numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扩展宏观涨落理论（MFT）的流体动力学框架，研究了扩散系统在非平稳状态下的多时间电流涨落统计。对非相互作用格子气体和硬核布朗点粒子给出了显式解，对一般系统给出微扰解，并揭示电流涨落与分数布朗运动之间的联系在阶梯初始条件下不成立。
AI.motivation: 非平衡物理中电流涨落的统计研究长期以来集中于单时间统计量，多时间推广相对较少被探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，将MFT框架扩展到多时间统计的研究。
AI.method: 扩展宏观涨落理论（MFT）的框架，在无限直线上的扩散系统中研究多时间统计。对最简单的非相互作用格子气体和硬核布朗点粒子给出MFT的显式解；对一般系统采用微扰求解MFT，得到两时间关联的显式结果，并通过微观动力学求解和数值模拟进行独立验证。
AI.result: 对于非相互作用气体和对称简单排他过程（SSEP），给出了多时间大偏差统计的显式解；对一般系统给出了两时间关联的微扰结果。发现电流涨落与分数布朗运动之间的联系在平直初始条件下成立，但在阶梯初始条件下不再成立。
AI.conclusion: MFT框架可成功推广至扩散系统非平稳状态下的多时间统计研究。当前涨落与分数布朗运动的联系依赖于初始条件，阶梯初始条件下该联系不复存在，微观动力学验证和数值模拟均支持流体动力学结果。

title: Spin nematic liquid crystal and scalar spin chirality in tetragonal lattice YbMnBi$_2$
summary: A spin nematic order, analogous to the nematic liquid crystal, characterizes the spontaneous breaking of spin-space rotational symmetry while preserving time-reversal ($T$) symmetry. In contrast, scalar spin chirality (SSC), a composite three-spin order, breaks $T$ symmetry and is known to induce an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Although a spin nematic phase has been suggested in frustrated magnets and the square-lattice iridate, how it might affect magnetotransport properties is unknown. Here we use polarized neutron scattering to show that tetragonal $A$MnBi$_2$ ($A$ = Ca, Yb) is a strictly $c$-axis-aligned collinear antiferromagnet (C-type), with $T_N \approx 270$ K and 290 K, respectively. On cooling from 450 K to $T_N$, low-energy spin excitations in YbMnBi$_2$ spontaneously change from isotropic to anisotropic in spin space within the tetragonal plane, forming a dynamic spin nematic phase around 400 K due to heavy Yb-induced spin-orbit coupling, before gapping out below $T_N$. Similar measurements on CaMnBi$_2$ reveal isotropic paramagnetic scattering without a spin nematic phase above $T_N$. Under an in-plane magnetic field, the Yb$^{3+}$ moments may interact with the dynamic spin nematic phase to induce nonzero SSC, giving rise to AHE and an anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) in YbMnBi$_2$ that are absent in CaMnBi$_2$ above $T_N$. A symmetry-based Ginzburg-Landau analysis shows that coupling terms between the nematic order and SSC are allowed under an external magnetic field, which could explain the rapid increase of AHE with field in YbMnBi$_2$. Our results provide compelling evidence for dynamic SSC-induced AHE and ANE in the paramagnetic phase of a compensated collinear antiferromagnet, opening a new avenue for the physics of composite spin orders and room-temperature spintronics without magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 本文通过极化中子散射实验证明，在四方晶系A族MnBi₂（A=Ca, Yb）中，YbMnBi₂在冷却过程中（450 K至T_N≈270 K）自发形成动态自旋向列相（自旋空间旋转对称性破缺但时间反演对称性保持），该相源于Yb重离子诱导的自旋轨道耦合。在外加平面内磁场下，Yb³⁺矩与动态自旋向列相互作用可诱导非零标量自旋手性（SSC），从而在该补偿共线反铁磁体的顺磁相中产生反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE），而CaMnBi₂则无此现象。对称性基Ginzburg-Landau分析解释了AHE随磁场快速增大的行为。
AI.motivation: 探索自旋向列相（nematic order）如何影响磁输运性质。此前已知自旋向列相存在于受挫磁体和四方晶系铱酸盐中，但该相对磁输运（如AHE）的影响完全未知。本工作旨在揭示动态自旋向列相是否以及如何通过与SSC耦合产生反常霍尔/能斯特效应，从而在不具有静态磁有序的材料中实现室温自旋电子学。
AI.method: 采用极化中子散射技术表征A\u200bMnBi₂（A=Ca, Yb）的自旋结构和激发谱；通过对比YbMnBi₂与CaMnBi₂在冷却过程中的自旋激发各向异性变化识别动态自旋向列相；在面内磁场条件下测量霍尔和能斯特效应；并运用对称性基Ginzburg-Landau理论分析向列序与SSC之间的耦合允许项来解释实验观测。
AI.result: （1）A\u200bMnBi₂均为严格的c轴共线反铁磁（C型），T_N分别为~270 K（Yb）和~290 K（Ca）；（2）YbMnBi₂在~400 K附近形成动态自旋向列相，而CaMnBi₂无此相；（3）面内磁场下YbMnBi₂出现AHE和ANE，CaMnBi₂则没有；（4）Ginzburg-Landau分析表明向列序与SSC在磁场下允许耦合，解释了AHE随场的快速增强。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在补偿共线反铁磁体的顺磁相中首次提供了动态SSC诱导AHE和ANE的确凿证据，建立了动态自旋向列相与磁输运之间的联系，开辟了基于复合自旋序（无需静态磁有序）的室温自旋电子学新途径。

title: Robust Quantum Machine Learning for Collider Event Selection under Detector Variability
summary: Robust machine-learning methods are becoming increasingly important for high-energy physics data analysis as experiments enter the era of higher luminosity and future higher-energy colliders. Detector degradation, changing running conditions and calibration drift can shift data distributions, causing models trained on clean reference samples to degrade after deployment. We investigate whether parameterised quantum models provide a useful inductive bias for robust collider-event selection in two complementary settings. In the unsupervised study, quantum autoencoders trained on background events are compared with classical and variational autoencoders for anomaly detection. In the supervised study, quantum classifiers with data reuploading are trained to distinguish a supersymmetric signal from background and are compared with linear and multilayer-perceptron classifiers. All models are trained under reference conditions and subsequently evaluated under controlled feature-level smearing while their parameters and preprocessing transformations are held fixed. On clean inputs, the quantum autoencoders achieve competitive anomaly-detection performance, including in the low-false-positive-rate regime relevant for triggering, while the deeper data-reuploading classifier attains discrimination comparable to the non-linear classical baseline. Under smearing, the quantum models generally exhibit smaller shifts in their output scores and retain their discrimination more effectively than the expressive classical baselines. These results suggest that parameterised quantum models can provide a useful robustness inductive bias for collider-event selection and motivate further studies with realistic detector systematics, finite-shot statistics and quantum-device noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究参数化量子模型在高能物理对撞机事件筛选中对分布偏移的稳健性。在无监督异常检测和有监督超对称信号分类两种场景中，量子自编码器和数据重上传量子分类器在干净输入下性能与经典基线相当，且在特征涂抹（smearing）条件下输出分数偏移更小、判别能力保持更好，表明量子模型能提供有用的稳健性归纳偏置。
AI.motivation: 高能物理实验进入更高亮度和能量时代，探测器退化、运行条件变化和校准漂移会导致数据分布偏移，使基于干净参考样本训练的经典模型部署后性能下降。作者希望探究参数化量子模型是否能为对撞机事件选择提供稳健性归纳偏置，以应对数据分布漂移的挑战。
AI.method: 在两种互补设置中进行研究：(1) 无监督场景：量子自编码器用于异常检测，与经典变分自编码器比较；(2) 监督场景：带数据重上传的量子分类器区分超对称信号与背景，与线性和多层感知机分类器比较。所有模型在参考条件下训练，随后在保持参数和预处理变换固定的情况下，对受控特征级涂抹进行评估。
AI.result: 在干净输入上，量子自编码器取得与经典方法相当的异常检测性能（包括在低假阳性率触发相关区域），更深的数据重上传分类器达到与非线性经典基线的可比判别力。在涂抹条件下，量子模型的输出分数偏移通常更小，且比表达能力强的经典模型更好地保持判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 参数化量子模型可为对撞机事件选择提供有用的稳健性归纳偏置，值得在更现实的探测器系统误差、有限采样统计和量子器件噪声条件下进一步研究。

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of DPA-4 Force Fields to DFT+U Energetics: A Case Study in NiO
summary: Foundation machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) are often pretrained on broad materials datasets whose electronic-structure conventions may not reproduce the phase energetics required for a specific correlated material. Using NiO as a case study, we examine whether incorrect source-level phase energetics can be corrected efficiently through target-level fine-tuning. Along a common structural interpolation, non-spin-polarized PBE and ferromagnetic PBE+U predict opposite energetic orderings of the octahedral Oct and square-planar Sqr phases. Pretrained DPA-4 models adapt rapidly to the NiO PBE+U surface, reaching energy and force root-mean-square errors (RMSEs) of approximately 0.5 meV/atom and 30 meV/Å, respectively, with approximately 170 PBE+U labels. Crucially, models previously fine-tuned to the opposing no-U surface recover the qualitative PBE+U phase ordering with nearly the same target-data efficiency as models fine-tuned directly from their respective pretrained initializations. Our results show that incorrect source-level phase energetics can be reversed through target-level fine-tuning, and suggest a practical multi-fidelity strategy in which pretraining prioritizes broad, consistent, and affordable data, while compact target-level datasets impose energetics through application-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文以NiO为案例，研究了基础机器学习力场（MLFFs）在预训练时由于电子结构约定不同而导致的相能量错误是否可以通过目标层级的微调来高效纠正。结果显示，即使模型之前被微调到相反的（无U）能量表面，仅需约170个PBE+U标签，就能以与直接微调相当的数据效率恢复正确的PBE+U相序能量，表明源层级的相位能量错误可以通过目标层级微调逆转。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习力场（MLFFs）通常在广泛材料数据集上预训练，但这些数据集的电子结构约定可能无法复现特定关联材料所需的相能量学。作者想探究这种源层级错误是否可以通过目标层级的微调来有效纠正，从而为多保真度策略提供依据。
AI.method: 以NiO为案例，沿着一条常见的结构插值路径，比较了非自旋极化PBE与铁磁PBE+U两种方法对八面体（Oct）和平面正方形（Sqr）两相的能量序预测。对预训练的DPA-4模型分别进行两种目标的微调：直接从预训练初始化微调到PBE+U表面，以及先微调到无U表面再微调到PBE+U表面，对比两者的数据效率和能量序恢复能力。
AI.result: 预训练的DPA-4模型仅需约170个PBE+U标签即可快速适应NiO的PBE+U表面，达到约0.5 meV/atom的能量RMSE和约30 meV/Å的力RMSE。关键发现是：先前微调到相反（无U）表面的模型，恢复PBE+U定性相序所需的目标数据效率，与从各自预训练初始化直接微调的模型几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: 源层级的相位能量错误可以通过目标层级微调被逆转。这提示了一种实用的多保真度策略：预训练应优先考虑广泛、一致且成本可负担的数据，而紧凑的目标层级数据集通过面向特定应用的微调来施加所需的能量学约束。

title: Drift and Dependence: Layer-wise Information-Theoretic Bounds for Replay-Based Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning must absorb new tasks without erasing old ones, and replay---mixing a small buffer of past examples into current training---is among the most effective remedies for catastrophic forgetting. Yet its generalization behavior is shaped by two coupled effects that existing analyses fold into a single hypothesis-level quantity: finite memory replaces each past distribution with an empirical proxy, and repeated reuse couples the buffer, the current data, and the final hypothesis through a shared optimization trajectory. We develop a layer-wise information-theoretic framework that separates these effects at every depth. Our main result decomposes the expected generalization gap into a replay-induced representation drift and an optimization-dependence term, the latter further resolved into stability, plasticity, interaction, and residual-coupling components. Two refinements make the framework operational. A Wasserstein relaxation of the drift term, valid under support mismatch, yields a depth-dependent drift--sensitivity trade-off whose minimizer identifies which interior layer to stabilize. An SGLD instantiation of the optimization term reduces it to a trajectory-level log-determinant budget, exposing a curvature-aware gradient-alignment statistic that serves as an online diagnostic of task-wise forgetting. Controlled and benchmark experiments confirm the predicted memory scaling, the interior funnel, and the alignment signal's link to forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个逐层信息论框架，将持续学习中回放（replay）导致的泛化差距分解为表示漂移与优化依赖两部分，后者进一步分解为稳定性、可塑性、交互与残差耦合四个分量，并给出了可操作的Wasserstein松弛和SGLD轨迹级诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 持续学习需要在不遗忘旧任务的前提下吸收新知识，回放是最有效的缓解灾难性遗忘的方法之一。然而，回放的泛化行为受两个耦合效应影响：有限记忆用经验代理替换了每个旧任务的分布；重复复用使缓冲区、当前数据和最终假设通过共享优化轨迹耦合。现有分析通常将这两个效应合并为单一的假设级量，无法区分它们在不同网络深度上的作用。
AI.method: 提出逐层信息论框架将期望泛化差距分解为回放诱导的表示漂移项和优化依赖项；优化依赖项进一步分解为稳定性、可塑性、交互和残差耦合四个分量。为使其可操作，采用Wasserstein松弛处理漂移项的支持不匹配问题，导出深度相关的漂移-敏感度权衡，其最小化可确定应稳定哪个内部层；采用SGLD实例化优化项，将其化简为轨迹级对数行列式预算，揭示曲率感知的梯度对齐统计量作为任务遗忘的在线诊断。
AI.result: 受控实验和基准实验验证了预期的记忆缩放规律、内部漏斗现象以及梯度对齐信号与遗忘之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将回放中有限记忆与优化耦合两个效应在每一层深度上分离，提供了理论分解以及实际可用的稳定性定位与遗忘诊断工具。

title: Shortcuts to Parameter Sweeps
comment: 6 pages main text, 2 figures; 11 pages supplemental material
summary: Efficient evaluation of stationary parametric sensitivities over broad parameter ranges is important for identifying influential training data, fitting force fields, and predicting material responses, but standard pointwise approaches require repeated relaxation and sampling. Here we introduce Shortcuts to Parameter Sweeps (STPS), an engineered control strategy that uses an auxiliary control to transport the probability density along a prescribed family of instantaneous stationary states during a finite-time parameter sweep. This enables the continuous response curve over the full parameter interval to be estimated from a single controlled sweep using covariance-based response relations. STPS applies to both equilibrium and nonequilibrium steady-state systems, including those with unknown stationary distributions, and can be implemented directly using stationary samples in high-dimensional settings. Numerical tests on single-particle and interacting many-body systems show that STPS yields response curves in close agreement with reference results. These findings establish STPS as an efficient, sample-based framework for continuous sensitivity analysis in stochastic simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STPS（参数扫描捷径）控制策略，利用辅助控制在有限时间内将概率密度沿一族瞬时稳态传输，从而在一次受控扫描中通过协方差响应关系估计完整参数区间上的连续响应曲线，适用于平衡态和非平衡稳态系统，数值实验验证了其高效性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 在随机模拟中，跨广泛参数范围高效评估平稳参数敏感性对于识别有影响力的训练数据、拟合力场和预测材料响应至关重要，但标准逐点方法需要对每个参数点反复松弛和采样，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: STPS通过引入辅助控制，在有限时间的参数扫描过程中将概率密度沿着预设的瞬时平稳态族进行传输，利用协方差响应关系从单次受控扫描中估计完整参数区间上的连续响应曲线，可应用于平衡态和任意非平衡稳态系统（包括平稳分布未知的情形），并可在高维场景下直接使用平稳样本实现。
AI.result: 在单粒子和相互作用多体系统的数值测试中，STPS生成的响应曲线与参考结果高度一致，验证了该方法在平衡态和非平衡稳态系统中的有效性与准确性。
AI.conclusion: STPS为随机模拟中的连续敏感性分析提供了一种高效、基于样本的通用框架，有望在处理宽参数范围参数扫描任务时显著降低计算成本。

title: Phonon anomalies and critical scaling in the spin-$1/2$ trimer chain Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$
comment: Main text: 13 pages, 5 figures Supplemental material 14 pages, 14 figures
summary: Low-dimensional quantum magnets provide an ideal platform to explore spin-lattice coupling-mediated quantum correlations, which give rise to emergent quasiparticle excitations. The antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1/2 trimer chain of copper ions in Na$_2$Cu$_3$Ge$_4$O$_{12}$ (NCGO) hosts high-energy spin excitations of different species, whose energy scales overlap with those of lattice vibrations. Here, we report a comprehensive temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopic study performed between 80 and 400 K. The dynamic spin susceptibility, as obtained from the analysis of the broad spectral background, reveals the emergence of quasiparticle excitations below 170 K. We further identify an unusual crossover of phonon dynamics when the material transits from a normal paramagnetic state to a correlated quantum magnetic state. A power law dependence of the integrated Raman susceptibility of the phonon modes, $I_{χ^{\prime\prime}}^{i}\sim|T-T_{c}|^β$, is observed with the critical temperature $T_c$=167$\pm$1 K, and critical exponent $β= 0.24\pm 0.02$. The combined results obtained from the broad spectral background and sharp phonon peaks further indicate that the phonon renormalization observed across the crossover is driven by dynamic spin states. Additionally, statistical correlations among phonon energy eigenvalues, quantified through matrix-norm and power-test analyses of 200 spectra recorded at 80 K, reveal an unexpected linear correlation among phonon modes, also indicating that the collective lattice response is governed by spin correlations. These findings establish NCGO as a model system for investigating cooperative spin-lattice coupling and critical scaling behavior of phonon dynamics in low-dimensional magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过80–400 K温度依赖的拉曼光谱研究，揭示了低维量子磁体Na₂Cu₃Ge₄O₁₂（NCGO）中自旋-晶格耦合介导的声子动力学临界行为。研究发现170 K以下出现准粒子激发，声子重整化遵循幂律|T-Tc|^β，且声子模式间存在出乎意料的线性统计关联，表明集体晶格响应由自旋关联主导。
AI.motivation: 低维量子磁体为探索自旋-晶格耦合介导的量子关联及涌现准粒子激发提供了理想平台。NCGO中反铁磁耦合的自旋-1/2铜离子三聚体链所承载的高能自旋激发能标与晶格振动能标重叠，这使得研究自旋与晶格之间的协同耦合及其临界行为成为一个关键的科学问题。
AI.method: 对NCGO单晶进行80–400 K温度依赖的拉曼光谱测量；从宽谱背景分析提取动态自旋磁化率；通过声子模式的积分拉曼磁化率拟合其幂律临界标度关系；利用矩阵范数和幂检验方法对80 K下200个谱图的声子能量本征值进行统计分析。
AI.result: 在170 K以下观察到准粒子激发的涌现；识别出材料从正常顺磁态到关联量子磁态转变时声子动力学的异常交叉现象。声子模式的积分拉曼磁化率遵循幂律I~|T-Tc|^β，其中Tc=167±1 K，β=0.24±0.02。统计相关性分析揭示了声子模式间意外存在的线性关联。
AI.conclusion: 声子重整化由动态自旋态驱动，集体晶格响应受自旋关联支配，证实NCGO是研究低维磁性材料中协同自旋-晶格耦合及声子动力学临界标度行为的模型体系。

title: Holonomic quantum gates via continuous measurement in bosonic codes: GKP and cat states
summary: We apply continuous measurement-based holonomic quantum computation (CMHQC) to bosonic quantum error-correcting codes and develop explicit protocols for both four-component cat codes and Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes. In this framework, a continuously monitored time-dependent codespace undergoes a closed trajectory on the Grassmannian manifold while Zeno confinement suppresses departures from the instantaneous code subspace. For cat codes, we construct a family of squeezed-cat trajectories whose projected Wilczek-Zee connection generates arbitrary logical Z rotations, including non-Clifford T-gates. For GKP codes, we introduce a translated-lattice trajectory that realizes the logical GKP T gate through a purely geometric holonomy. We derive the corresponding time-dependent projectors, analytically evaluate the projected connections, and show that the resulting holonomies reproduce the desired logical operations without Hamiltonian control. Furthermore, we analyze the error-correcting capabilities of the instantaneous codespaces by establishing dressed Knill-Laflamme conditions for the relevant bosonic error models and derive analytical estimates for leakage induced by finite-strength continuous measurements. Our results provide a concrete realization of measurement-induced holonomic control in experimentally relevant bosonic platforms and establish a full fault-tolerant logical gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将连续测量驱动的全息量子计算（CMHQC）框架应用于玻色子量子纠错码，分别为四分量猫码和Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill（GKP）码开发了显式的逻辑门实现协议，通过Zeno限制和Grassmannian流形上的闭环轨迹产生几何相位，实现包括非Clifford T门在内的高保真逻辑操作。
AI.motivation: 传统全息量子计算依赖精确的哈密顿量控制来实现几何相位门，对控制噪声敏感且难以扩展到玻色子系统。作者希望利用连续测量诱导的Zeno效应替代哈密顿量控制，在实验上易于实现的玻色子平台上实现容错逻辑门操作，从而建立一条测量诱导全息控制的新路径。
AI.method: 将CMHQC框架应用于玻色子纠错码。对于猫码，构造一族压缩猫轨迹（squeezed-cat trajectories），其投影Wilczek-Zee联络可生成任意逻辑Z旋转（含T门）；对于GKP码，引入平移晶格轨迹（translated-lattice trajectory），通过纯几何全息实现逻辑GKP T门。推导了对应的时间依赖投影算子，解析计算投影联络，并建立dressed Knill-Laflamme条件分析瞬时码空间对相关玻色子误差模型的纠错能力，同时给出有限强度连续测量导致的泄漏的解析估计。
AI.result: 解析地证明了所构造的轨迹产生的全息算符能精确复现所需的逻辑操作（猫码的任意Z旋转和GKP码的T门），且无需哈密顿量控制。建立了玻色子误差模型下的dressed Knill-Laflamme条件，说明了瞬时码空间在该测量方案中的误差纠正能力，并给出了有限测量强度下泄漏率的解析估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为实验上相关的玻色子平台（如超导电路）提供了测量诱导全息操控的具体实现方案，建立了完整的容错逻辑门实现框架，为量子计算中利用连续测量作为控制机制提供了理论与技术的双重支撑。

title: Spiral structure from the interference of gravitational eigenmodes in ultralight dark matter halos
summary: We use a variety of analytic and numerical techniques to approximate the geometry of individual dark matter halos when modeled as collections of ultralight scalar bosons (ULDM), followed by an analysis on the future directions and implications of this work. Ultimately, we aim to understand the morphology and creation of complex structures (like spirals) in galaxies from a geometric standpoint and to investigate the connection between dark matter and baryonic matter in galaxies. We find that superpositions of gravitational eigenmodes for ULDM in a fixed background potential can yield spiral density perturbations which rotate on the order of one hundred million years and appear within ten to twenty kpc of the halo center, both features comparable to realistic galaxies, and that this model provides a natural explanation for the density waves necessary to seed baryonic spirals.

AI.tldr: 本文运用解析与数值技术近似描绘由超轻标量玻色子（ULDM）构成的暗物质晕的几何形态，发现引力本征模的叠加可产生在约1亿年时间尺度内旋转、位于晕中心10-20 kpc范围内的螺旋密度扰动，为星系中重子物质的螺旋结构提供了自然成因解释。
AI.motivation: 从几何学角度理解星系中复杂结构（如螺旋结构）的形态与成因，并探究暗物质与星系中重子物质之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用解析与数值相结合的技术，将暗物质晕建模为超轻标量玻色子的集合，分析其在固定背景势中引力本征模的叠加所产生的密度扰动。
AI.result: 研究发现，ULDM引力本征模的叠加能够产生旋转周期约1亿年、位于晕中心10-20 kpc范围内的螺旋密度扰动，这些特征与真实星系的螺旋结构相当，可为重子螺旋结构所需的密度波提供自然来源。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为星系螺旋结构的形成提供了几何层面的自然解释，揭示了ULDM暗物质与星系重子结构之间的潜在关联，并为未来研究方向（如复杂结构形成机制）奠定基础。

title: MOON: Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates for Multitask Learning
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has demonstrated significant success in multi-task learning by mitigating task conflicts through gradient manipulation. However, most existing methods flatten model parameters into vectors and perform gradient manipulation under Euclidean geometry, thereby overlooking the matrix structure prevalent in modern architectures such as Transformers. In this paper, we show that gradient manipulation in Euclidean space does not generally yield the steepest descent direction under matrix geometry, potentially limiting optimization efficiency. Drawing from the theory of steepest descent for matrix-valued parameters, we propose MOON (Multi-Objective OrthoNormalized Updates), which performs gradient manipulation under spectral--nuclear norm geometry and uses the orthonormalized manipulated gradient for parameter updates. Theoretically, for smooth non-convex objectives, we establish convergence of the averaged Pareto-stationarity measure at rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ in the deterministic setting and $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ under stochastic gradients. Empirical results across various benchmarks show that MOON consistently improves both optimization efficiency and final multi-task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/KunlinLyu/MOON.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOON方法，在谱-核范数几何下进行多目标优化的梯度操作，利用正交归一化更新参数，突破传统欧几里得空间中忽视矩阵结构的局限，在理论和实验上均取得更优的收敛速度与多任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MOO方法将模型参数展平成向量并在欧几里得几何下进行梯度操作，忽略了现代架构（如Transformer）中参数天然具有的矩阵结构。作者指出欧氏空间中的梯度操作并非矩阵几何意义下的最陡下降方向，可能限制优化效率。
AI.method: 基于矩阵参数的最陡下降理论，MOON在谱-核范数几何（spectral-nuclear norm geometry）下执行梯度操作，使用归一化后的操纵梯度（orthonormalized manipulated gradient）进行参数更新，以适配参数的矩阵结构。
AI.result: 理论上，对光滑非凸目标，在确定性设定下Pareto-平稳性度量的平均收敛率为O(T^{-1/2})，在随机梯度设定下为O(T^{-1/4})。实验上，在多个基准上MOON一致地提升了优化效率和多任务最终性能。
AI.conclusion: MOON通过将多任务梯度操作置于合适的矩阵几何中，有效解决了欧氏空间中梯度操纵对矩阵参数结构忽视的问题，兼顾了理论收敛保证和实际性能提升，代码已开源。

title: Finite-depth scaling and an exact Bernoulli-leaf identity for the min-plus process on the binary tree
summary: The min-plus process is a stochastic coagulation-annihilation-type process on the binary tree, of interest in mathematics, physics, and computer science as a tractable instance of max-type recursive distributional equations. We carry out large Monte Carlo simulations at effective tree depths up to $N=60$ that provide finite-depth corroboration of the Beta(2,1) stretched-exponential limit for its root value $X_{N}$ at $p=1/2$, on the asymmetric $\sqrt{N}$ side of the random-homogeneous-systems classification recently introduced by Chen, Duquesne, and Shi and by Morfe.
