AI.result: 测得芯片间克隆保真度为78.45±1.39%，超过经典克隆极限（2/3）达8个标准差，验证了最优克隆的量子优势。实验结果证明了集成芯片间复杂多光子态的稳健制备与操控能力。
AI.conclusion: 该实验成功实现了可扩展硅光平台上最优的1到2对称量子遥克隆，展示了跨芯片多光子纠缠资源的可靠生成与干涉操作。该工作为大规模多方量子网络的构建提供了基础模块，具有重要的实际应用前景。

title: Do Not Let CNOTs Overwhelm the Decoder: Scheduling Transversal Gates for Fast FTQC
summary:
Transversal CNOT (TCNOT) gates can accelerate fault-tolerant quantum computation (FTQC) in the surface code by reducing the number of syndrome extraction rounds required between logical operations from $O(d)$ to $O(1)$. This is particularly attractive for quantum platforms with long-range connectivity, such as neutral atoms. However, dense TCNOT schedules substantially increase the classical decoding workload. TCNOTs propagate errors across multiple surface-code patches, enlarging the spatiotemporal region that must be decoded jointly. Consequently, denser TCNOT schedules increase decoding latency and memory requirements and potentially exceed available decoder capacity. Moreover, because the detector error model (DEM) of each decoding window depends on the TCNOT schedule, exhaustively precomputing all possible window-level DEMs is infeasible, requiring just-in-time (JIT) DEM compilation. Thus, the practical benefit of TCNOT gates is limited not only by quantum hardware performance but also by classical decoding and DEM-compilation capacity.
  We introduce PACE, a decoder-aware scheduling framework for TCNOT-based FTQC. PACE first mitigates the decoder-side costs of aggressive TCNOT scheduling through three complementary techniques. Hybrid Window Decoding assigns different decoders for each decoding window according to its DEM structure. DEM Stitch generates schedule-specific window-level DEMs just in time by assembling reusable precompiled fragments. Sub-window Parallel Decoding decomposes large windows into smaller sub-windows with graph-coloring formulation. Building on these techniques, PACE then performs decoder-aware scheduling to maximize TCNOT concurrency within the available decoder resources. Our evaluation shows the trade-off between quantum acceleration and classical decoding cost, revealing the limitations of current decoding systems for TCNOT-based FTQC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE框架，一种面向TCNOT（横向CNOT）门容错量子计算的解码器感知调度框架，通过混合窗口解码、DEM缝合和子窗口并行解码三种技术缓解密集TCNOT调度带来的经典解码负担，并在可用解码资源内最大化TCNOT并发度。
AI.motivation: TCNOT门虽然能将表面码中逻辑操作间的综合征提取轮数从O(d)降至O(1)，尤其适合中性原子等长程连接平台，但密集的TCNOT调度会显著增加经典解码工作量：错误传播跨越多个表面码补丁，扩大了需要联合解码的时空区域，导致解码延迟和内存需求增加；同时每个解码窗口的探测器错误模型（DEM）取决于TCNOT调度，预计算所有可能的窗口级DEM不可行，需要即时（JIT）DEM编译。因此TCNOT的实际效益同时受限于量子硬件性能和经典解码与DEM编译能力。
AI.method: PACE框架包含三项核心技术：(1) 混合窗口解码（Hybrid Window Decoding）：根据每个解码窗口的DEM结构分配不同的解码器；(2) DEM缝合（DEM Stitch）：通过组装可复用的预编译片段，即时生成调度特定的窗口级DEM；(3) 子窗口并行解码（Sub-window Parallel Decoding）：利用图着色问题公式将大窗口分解为更小的子窗口。基于这些技术，PACE执行解码器感知调度，在可用解码资源内最大化TCNOT并发度。
AI.result: 评估揭示了量子加速与经典解码成本之间的权衡，展示了当前解码系统在TCNOT容错量子计算中的局限性。
AI.conclusion: TCNOT的实际效益不仅受量子硬件性能限制，还受限于经典解码和DEM编译能力；PACE通过解码器感知的调度框架在可用解码资源内优化TCNOT并发度，为评估和设计TCNOT-based FTQC的解码系统提供了新的视角。

title: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
summary: Effective implementation of high-level quantum gates is essential for practical quantum computing. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first reported 12-CNOT decomposition of the double qubit excitation operator, improving upon state-of-the-art (SOTA) implementations with 13 CNOTs. Our new circuit has the lowest CNOT count (12), lowest CNOT depth (10), and lowest total circuit depth (16) among all the previous SOTA circuits. Further, we only added 2 extra one-qubit gates compared to the lowest one-qubit gate count (11) among the previous SOTA circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文首次报道了双量子比特激发算符的12-CNOT分解方案，相比于现有最优（SOTA）的13-CNOT实现有所改进，在CNOT数量（12）、CNOT深度（10）和总电路深度（16）上均为最低，且仅比最低单比特门数量（11）多2个额外单比特门。
AI.motivation: 高质量量子门的高效实现是实用量子计算的关键，降低CNOT数量与电路深度对于减少量子电路噪声传播和提升量子计算可行性至关重要。现有最优方案为13个CNOT，作者希望进一步突破这一纪录。
AI.method: 通过对双量子比特激发算符的电路结构进行优化设计和数学推导，提出了一种新的分解算法，实现了12个CNOT的新分解方案，并在CNOT深度和总电路深度上也进行了优化。
AI.result: 新电路在CNOT数量（12）、CNOT深度（10）和总电路深度（16）方面均优于所有现有SOTA电路，且仅付出了2个额外单比特门的小代价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为双量子比特激发算符的电路分解提供了新的最优方案，有助于推进实用量子计算的发展。

title: Antibunching Enhancement via Non-Markovianity in a Hybrid Optical-Microwave Cross-Cavity
summary: Unconventional photon blockade (UPB) provides an attractive route for generating antibunched light through quantum interference without requiring strong nonlinear coupling. In conventional Markovian systems, irreversible dissipation progressively destroys the phase coherence, even limiting the achievable single-photon purity. Here we propose a scheme for imposing non-Markovian effects on a microwave cavity where a Er$^{3+}$:Y$_2$SiO$_5$ crystal loaded into a hybrid optical-microwave system. Based on the time-convolutionless non-Markovian framework, we derive the time-dependent non-Markovian decay rate and the renormalized microwave drive in the weak-coupling regime. We show that the second-order correlation function is significantly suppressed, even to the order of $10^{-7}$, since the backflow of environmental information enhances photon blocking. In addition, this structured reservoir engineering not only provides an additional degree of freedom, but also further optimizes the blockade via optical detuning. Importantly, the delayed second-order correlation exhibits a broadened antibunching profile, thereby relaxing the timing requirements for single-photon synchronization. Our results demonstrate that environmental non-Markovianity can be transformed from a source of decoherence into a controllable quantum resource, opening new opportunities for high-purity single-photon generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在混合光-微波系统中利用掺铒晶体（Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅）构造非马尔可夫环境，通过环境信息的回流增强非传统光子阻塞（UPB），实现二阶关联函数低至10⁻⁷的高纯度反聚束单光子产生，并将非马尔可夫性从退相干源转化为可控量子资源。
AI.motivation: 传统马尔可夫系统中，不可逆耗散会逐渐破坏相位相干性，限制光子阻塞效应可达到的单光子纯度；非马尔可夫效应通常被视为有害的退相干来源，但若能在弱耦合条件下对其加以利用与调控，有望突破马尔可夫极限，获得更高纯度的单光子源。
AI.method: 在混合光-微波系统中将Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅晶体装载入微波腔，基于时间卷积消除（time-convolutionless）非马尔可夫框架，在弱耦合区推导含时的非马尔可夫衰减率与重整化微波驱动；通过结构化储层工程调控光学失谐，分析二阶关联函数与延迟二阶关联函数的反聚束特性。
AI.result: 非马尔可夫效应通过环境信息回流增强光子阻塞，使二阶关联函数显著抑制至10⁻⁷量级；光学失谐可进一步优化阻塞效果，提供额外调控自由度；延迟二阶关联函数呈现展宽的反聚束轮廓，放宽了单光子同步的时间精度要求。
AI.conclusion: 环境非马尔可夫性可被转化为可控量子资源而非单纯的退相干源，为高纯度单光子产生提供了新的技术途径，也为非马尔可夫量子态工程开辟了新的方向。

title: Continuous-variable state moments from randomized homodyne and heterodyne measurements
summary: Continuous-variable (CV) quantum states are naturally characterized by their moments, defined as expectation values of products of single- or multimode ladder operators. Many CV Hamiltonians and quantum algorithms are formulated directly in terms of these moments, and therefore an efficient procedure to estimate moments with limited state measurements is necessary. In this paper, we present a protocol for shadow tomography of moment-generating functions (MGFs) of CV states based on randomized homodyne and heterodyne measurements. The resulting shadows enable an efficient and concurrent estimation of many multimode moments. Our complexity analysis shows that the number of measurements required to estimate a certain moment to a given precision grows exponentially in the order of the moments. Finally, we assess the precision of these moment estimators by applying them to two tasks: detecting entanglement in both Gaussian and non-Gaussian states via the Shchukin-Vogel protocol, and characterizing optical loss in a photonic chip. We demonstrate that both tasks can be accomplished with only a few thousand randomized measurements. The small number of required measurements, combined with efficient sample processing, makes our protocol applicable to a wide range of CV simulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机零差和外差测量的连续变量（CV）量子态矩生成函数（MGF）阴影断层扫描协议，可高效并发估计多模矩，并应用于纠缠检测和光子芯片损耗表征，仅需数千次随机测量即可完成任务。
AI.motivation: 连续变量量子态由其矩（阶梯算符乘积的期望值）自然描述，许多CV哈密顿量和量子算法直接以矩为基础构建。然而，在有限态测量条件下高效估计这些矩需要一种系统性协议，以便在实验和算法中可靠获得所需的矩信息。
AI.method: 基于随机零差（homodyne）和零差外差（heterodyne）测量的阴影断层扫描协议，用于估计CV量子态的矩生成函数（MGF），从而实现对多模矩的并发高效估计。复杂度分析表明所需测量次数随矩阶数指数增长。
AI.result: 通过Shchukin-Vogel协议检测高斯和非高斯态的纠缠，以及表征光子芯片中的光学损耗两项任务验证了精度，两项任务均仅需几千次随机测量即可完成。
AI.conclusion: 协议所需测量次数少、样本处理效率高，适用于广泛的CV模拟任务，为连续变量量子态的矩估计提供了实用且高效的方案。

title: Quantum Inequalities from the Second Law
comment: Published in the International Journal of Theoretical Physics
summary: Quantum field theory allows local violations of the classical energy conditions, such as regions of negative energy density. The Ford-Roman quantum inequalities quantify how negative these regions can be and for how long. We present a derivation of these inequalities from the second law of thermodynamics, in an operational framework that couples the field to a small thermal detector. The detector acts as a physical probe of the field's energy density and, by the non-negativity of the entanglement entropy between the two systems, one can show that its heat loss is bounded from below by a state-independent quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文从热力学第二定律出发，在一个将场耦合到小型热探测器的操作框架中推导出了Ford-Roman量子不等式。
AI.motivation: 量子场论允许经典能量条件的局部违反（如负能量密度区域），而Ford-Roman量子不等式量化了这些负能量区域的强度和持续时间。作者希望从更基本的物理原理（热力学第二定律）出发推导这些不等式，从而提供新的理论视角。
AI.method: 采用操作化框架，将量子场耦合到一个小型热探测器上，利用探测器作为场的能量密度的物理探针。通过两个系统之间纠缠熵的非负性，证明探测器的热损失受到一个与状态无关的下界的约束。
AI.result: 从量子场与热探测器相互作用的纠缠熵非负性出发，推导出探测器的热损失具有状态无关的下界，从而导出Ford-Roman量子不等式。
AI.conclusion: Ford-Roman量子不等式可以从热力学第二定律（结合纠缠熵非负性和操作化探测器框架）推导出来，为量子能量条件的约束提供了热力学基础。

title: Uniformly Stable Minimal Weyl--Heisenberg Measurements Approaching the SIC Benchmark
summary: Informational completeness (IC) guarantees that an inverse exists, not that it is statistically well conditioned. For minimal rank-one Weyl--Heisenberg (WH) measurements, covariance makes the nonidentity projector-Gram spectrum proportional to the fiducial's ambiguity intensities, with eigenvalues \(d|χ_φ(u)|^2\), turning stability into an explicit worst-direction design problem; write \(λ\) for its smallest nonidentity eigenvalue. Haar fiducials are IC almost surely while \(\mathbb E[λ^{-1}]=\infty\), and an explicit geometric family used to establish balanced informationally complete measurements in every dimension has a normalized spectral floor bounded above by an exponentially decaying envelope. We then construct a hierarchy of minimal measurements. A cyclic family with exactly \(d^2\) outcomes in every integer dimension has floors \(Θ(d^{-3})\) for odd \(d\) and \(Θ(d^{-5})\) for even \(d\); a finite-field family for \(q=2^m\) obeys the uniform bound \(λ\ge4/9\). Our main result treats every prime-power dimension of characteristic \(p\ge5\). A balanced one-coordinate perturbation repairs the zero ambiguity axis of a cubic Alltop state, gives an attained floor uniformly bounded below by a positive constant, and confines the entire nonidentity spectrum to \([L_q,U_q]\) with \(U_q/L_q\to1\). Its SIC-normalized minimum tends to one, and \(λ(φ_q)/Λ_q^\star\to1\) for the global finite-field WH max--min optimum \(Λ_q^\star\), without assuming SIC existence. The complete spectrum determines the exact finite-sample Hilbert--Schmidt error of canonical linear inversion at \(I/d\), while its lower edge controls local Fisher efficiency and canonical-shadow bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究最小秩一Weyl-Heisenberg测量的信息完备性（IC）与统计良态性之间的关系。IC仅保证逆存在，但不保证统计条件良好。作者构造了一系列最小测量层次结构：包括循环族、有限域族，以及针对每个素数幂维度的"平衡单坐标扰动"族，后者将非平凡谱限制在一个渐近趋于1的窄区间内，且归一化最小特征值趋于1，无需假设SIC存在。
AI.motivation: 信息完备性（IC）是测量设计的基本要求，但现有研究表明IC并不自动保证逆的统计良态性。Haar族几乎必然IC但期望逆特征值无穷大；现有平衡IC测量的谱下界呈指数衰减。因此需要构造一类既满足IC又具有良好统计条件数的测量族，特别是在每个素数幂维度中实现均匀有界的谱下界。
AI.method: 作者首先分析最小秩一WH测量的谱结构，将其与标准向量的模糊度强度关联，得到特征值d|χ_φ(u)|^2。随后构造三个层次的测量族：(1) 循环族，在奇数维和偶数维分别给出Θ(d^{-3})和Θ(d^{-5})的谱下界；(2) 有限域族（q=2^m），满足均匀下界λ≥4/9；(3) 核心结果——对特征p≥5的素幂维度，通过对立方Alltop态进行平衡单坐标扰动，修复其零模糊度轴，构造出谱完全限制在[L_q,U_q]且U_q/L_q→1的测量族。
AI.result: 核心结果表明：对于所有特征p≥5的素幂维度，构造出的测量族具有均匀正下界的谱下界（至少达到的界），整个非恒等谱被限制在渐近缩小的区间[L_q,U_q]中。其SIC归一化最小值趋于1，且λ(φ_q)/Λ_q^*→1，达到了全局有限域WH最大-最小最优值，且无需假设SIC存在。完整谱还精确决定了在I/d处的有限样本Hilbert-Schmidt误差，下边缘控制局部Fisher效率和canonical-shadow界。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了信息完备测量与统计良态性之间的系统层级划分，并给出了最优构造：平衡单坐标扰动的立方Alltop态在每个素幂维度（p≥5）上实现了渐近最优的谱行为，其谱收敛到单点，SIC归一化的最小特征值趋于1，达到了有限域WH最大-最小意义下的全局最优值。这项工作无需依赖SIC存在性假设，为高维量子态层析提供了统计上最优的测量设计方案。

title: Limitations on Joint Coherence Transfer in Quantum Thermodynamics
summary:
Coherences between different energy levels are strongly constrained by thermodynamics. Here we ask a related question: if several coherence transfers can be optimized separately, can they also be optimized simultaneously by the same thermodynamic process? We show that this is in general a compatibility problem. Using an energy-resolved Stinespring representation of thermal operations, we express elementary coherence-transfer amplitudes as inner products of bath-weighted vectors associated with total-energy shells. Saturation of the corresponding Cauchy--Schwarz bounds requires these vectors to be collinear. Since all transfers have to arise from the same energy-preserving system--bath unitary, such saturation conditions cannot in general be imposed independently. Trace and Gibbs preservation lead to additional phase-closure conditions and to polygon inequalities that can rule out simultaneous saturation for fixed population-transfer data.
  We complement these analytic results with a rigorous computer-assisted semidefinite-program analysis. For the mixed-degenerate Hamiltonian $H=\operatorname{diag}(0,1,1,3)$, machine-certified primal and dual bounds show that no covariant Gibbs-preserving channel can simultaneously attain three individually optimal directional coherence transfers. Since every thermal operation is covariant and Gibbs preserving, the same triple of optimal values cannot be attained by a thermal operation. We further relate this incompatibility to range-inclusion constraints in Choi-sector Gram matrices for mixed-degenerate energy levels. Our results show that coherence transfers which are optimal when considered separately need not be compatible with one physical thermodynamic process. A full characterization of this incompatibility directly within thermal operations remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不同能量级之间的相干性转移能否由一个热力学过程同时优化。作者发现这本质上是一个兼容性问题：使用能量分辨的Stinespring表示，将基本相干转移振幅表达为与总能量壳层相关的浴加权向量的内积，Cauchy-Schwarz界的饱和要求这些向量共线。由于所有转移来自同一个能量守恒的系统和浴酉变换，这些饱和条件通常不能独立施加。作者通过半定规划分析了混合简并哈密顿量H=diag(0,1,1,3)，机器验证表明没有任何协变吉布斯保持通道能同时达到三个单独最优的有向相干转移。
AI.motivation: 热力学对不同能级间的相干性有严格约束。一个自然的问题是：如果多个相干转移可以分别单独优化，它们能否被同一个热力学过程同时优化？这个问题关系到量子热力学中多任务最优化的基本可行性。
AI.method: 使用能量分辨的Stinespring表示热操作，将基本相干转移振幅表达为与总能量壳层相关的浴加权向量的内积。利用Cauchy-Schwarz不等式分析饱和条件（需向量共线），并引入迹保持和吉布斯保持带来的相位闭合条件和多边形不等式。辅以严格的计算机辅助半定规划（SDP）分析，对混合简并哈密顿量H=diag(0,1,1,3)进行机器验证。
AI.result: 对于H=diag(0,1,1,3)，机器认证的原对偶界表明没有协变吉布斯保持通道能同时达到三个单独最优的有向相干转移。由于每个热操作都是协变且吉布斯保持的，因此同一组最优值也无法由热操作实现。这种不相容性与混合简并能级Choi扇区Gram矩阵中的范围包含约束有关。
AI.conclusion: 单独考虑时最优的相干转移不一定是物理热力学过程所兼容的。在热操作内对这种不相容的完整特征化仍然是一个开放问题。

title: CoQui: A Coordinate-Conditioned Quantum Implicit Generative Adversarial Network for End-to-End Image Generation
summary: Quantum generative adversarial networks (QGANs) have attracted increasing attention for image generation using parameterized quantum circuits. Existing amplitude-based approaches face two key limitations: pixel locations are typically encoded by computational-basis indices or address qubits, causing quantum resources to grow with image resolution; meanwhile, jointly decoding many pixels from normalized quantum states introduces probability competition among pixels and limits precise pixel-wise control. To address these issues, we reformulate quantum image generation as coordinate-conditioned implicit function learning. Our method takes spatial coordinates and latent variables as inputs, uses a classical embedding network to generate input-dependent circuit parameters, and evaluates a variational quantum circuit at each coordinate. Pixel intensities are directly obtained from the expectation value of a dedicated color qubit, and a complete image is generated by querying all spatial coordinates. This design decouples image resolution from address-qubit requirements and avoids shared probability-normalization constraints across pixels. We further design a specialized variational quantum circuit to provide structural inductive bias for coordinate-conditioned generation. Simulated experiments on two benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms FRQI-based generation and PQWGAN in visual and quantitative quality while using fewer qubits, and also achieves better generation quality than the corresponding classical baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将量子图像生成重新表述为坐标条件隐函数学习，以解决现有基于振幅的QGAN在图像生成中的两个关键局限性（量子资源随分辨率增长、像素间概率竞争），通过经典嵌入网络生成电路参数并在每个坐标处评估变分量子电路，直接从专用颜色量子比特的期望值获取像素强度，实现了与分辨率解耦且无共享概率归一化约束的量子图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于振幅的量子生成对抗网络（QGAN）在处理图像生成时存在两大局限：其一，像素位置通常通过计算基索引或地址量子比特编码，导致量子资源随图像分辨率线性增长；其二，从归一化量子态联合解码多个像素会产生像素间的概率竞争，限制了对单个像素的精确控制。这些缺陷阻碍了QGAN在图像生成任务中的可扩展性和精度，亟需一种新的范式来克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 本文将量子图像生成重新定义为坐标条件隐函数学习问题。具体而言：(1) 以空间坐标和潜在变量作为输入；(2) 使用经典嵌入网络生成与输入相关的电路参数；(3) 在每个坐标处评估变分量子电路；(4) 像素强度直接从专用颜色量子比特的期望值获得；(5) 通过查询所有空间坐标来生成完整图像。该设计将图像分辨率与地址量子比特需求解耦，避免了像素间共享概率归一化约束。此外，还专门设计了具有结构归纳偏置的变分量子电路以支持坐标条件生成。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上的模拟实验表明，所提方法在视觉质量和定量指标上均优于基于FRQI的生成方法和PQWGAN，同时使用更少的量子比特；并且还优于对应的经典基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将量子图像生成转化为坐标条件隐函数学习框架，成功解决了振幅编码方法中量子资源随分辨率增长以及像素间概率竞争的问题，在更少量子比特消耗下实现了更高质量的图像生成，展现出量子生成模型在图像任务中的潜力。

title: The optimization landscape of peaked-circuit generation
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Analysis code, logs and data archived on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21893815, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21893670); see the Data and code availability section
summary: Peaked circuits are random quantum circuits whose measurement returns one bitstring far more often than chance. They are a candidate route to verifiable quantum advantage, and the bottleneck is classical generation. Aaronson and Zhang fix a random circuit, append a trainable brickwall of half that depth, and optimize it by gradient descent to raise the probability of one chosen output string. Their method plateaus at a size-dependent ceiling, which they attribute to a barren plateau. A dichotomy remains open: either the optimizer stops short, so a better algorithm would reach higher, or no efficient method exists. We map the landscape on which the answer depends. Across 18 instances per size at n = 8-16, at fixed and converged budgets, no fixed-base exponential, the law they fit, matches the optimizer's reach: at convergence the decay steepens from 1.16 to 1.295 per qubit through n = 16 (p = 0.011 frozen and 0.025 converged, on n = 8-14 alone), leaving their n = 50 estimate unsupported; at n = 16 they report more than we reach at any budget measured. One optimizer beats ours: L-BFGS-B ends 3.9 +/- 1.6% above converged Adam at n = 16, on three instances. That margin retires our hardness conjecture under its registered rule and leaves the rate untouched: every optimizer measured loses a factor 1.3 per qubit. The barren plateau is present and cannot explain that rate: the reach sits far above the Haar floor 2^-n, and the exact second-order amplitude data are depth-independent while the reach is not. Nor do solutions cluster at that floor: they are decorrelated yet path-connected by paths 10^2-10^3 above 2^-n whose floor falls from 0.73 to 0.23 of the endpoints. Path search is one-sided, so near-optimal clustering stays open. In the deep limit we prove no poly(n)-parameter family beats poly(n) 2^-n on average. What survives: a connected landscape and a shrinking reach.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测绘了peaked circuits（尖峰量子电路）优化景观，检验了Aaronson-Zhang方法中关于优化器停滞于尺寸依赖天花板并归因于贫瘠高原的论断。跨18个实例、n=8-16规模下，作者发现原有指数拟合不成立，收敛后衰减从每量子位1.16加剧到1.295；L-BFGS-B优于Adam约3.9±1.6%，推翻作者自身的硬度猜想；但所有优化器每量子位均损失1.3倍，贫瘠高原无法解释该速率（reach远高于Haar下限2^-n，且二阶振幅数据深度无关而reach不是）。作者还发现解虽去相关但存在路径连通性，并证明在深度极限下无poly(n)参数族能以平均性能击败poly(n)2^-n。
AI.motivation: Aaronson-Zhang方法在梯度下降优化peaked circuits时出现随规模增长的停滞天花板，但归因于贫瘠高原的结论存在争议，且存在二分困境：要么优化器运行不足（更好的算法可达更高），要么不存在高效方法。本文旨在通过系统测绘优化景观来刻画这个答案所依赖的景观结构。
AI.method: 在n=8-16的18个实例上固定和收敛预算下，测绘优化器的可达范围；比较Adam与L-BFGS-B两类优化器的性能；分析衰减律的指数拟合；采集精确二阶振幅数据以检验深度无关性；研究解空间的去相关性和路径连通性；并给出深度极限下关于poly(n)参数族的平均性能定理证明。
AI.result: 原拟合的固定底指数在收敛时失效：衰减从每量子位1.16加剧到1.295（p=0.011/0.025），使n=50的估计不受支持；n=16处报告的数值高于作者在所有测得预算下的可达值。L-BFGS-B在n=16的三个实例上比收敛的Adam高出3.9±1.6%，推翻了作者按注册规则成立的硬度猜想。所有优化器每量子位损失1.3倍；贫瘠高原无法解释该速率，因为reach远高于Haar下限2^-n，且二阶振幅深度无关而reach深度相关。解的连通路径高出2^-n达10^2-10^3倍，其下界从端点0.73降至0.23。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出：连接景观（connected landscape）与收缩可达范围（shrinking reach）是保留的核心现象。硬度的二分困境中，作者本身的硬度猜想不被数据支持，但每量子位固定1.3倍损失率的存在表明某种系统性的尺度限制仍然存在；贫瘠高原的归因被排除，路径搜索的单向性意味着近优聚类问题仍然开放。

title: Perfect State Transfer on Oriented Circulant Graphs: A Complete Classification
summary: The continuous-time quantum walk on an oriented circulant graph is determined by the Fourier eigenvalues of its Hermitian adjacency matrix. We classify perfect state transfer (PST) between distinct vertices in every nonempty oriented circulant graph. We show that each such graph is described by an odd primitive quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $Δ$, a set of gcd-classes, and a choice between the two orientations of each selected class. For a graph of order $n$, we derive an explicit formula for every Fourier eigenvalue without assuming that $n/Δ$ is coprime to $Δ$. We prove that PST occurs only for $Δ\in\{3,4,8\}$ and give necessary and sufficient conditions on the connection set for each conductor. Equivalently, the square-free radicands of oriented circulant graphs with PST are exactly $1$, $2$, and $3$. More generally, when $λ_j=\sqrt{D}η_j$ with $η_j\in\mathbb{Z}$, congruences satisfied by the integers $η_j$ determine all PST pairs and times, the minimum period, and the largest vertex sets supporting multiple state transfer (MST). In this class, pretty good state transfer is equivalent to PST. We also determine the connected orders and enumerate the resulting graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文对有向循环图（oriented circulant graphs）上的连续时间量子游走中的完美态转移（PST）进行了完整的分类。作者证明每个非空有向循环图可由奇原二次狄利克雷特征、gcd-类集合及每类方向的选取来描述，并证明PST仅当导子Δ∈{3,4,8}时发生，等价地平方自由根号数恰为1、2、3。
AI.motivation: 量子游走是量子信息处理和量子计算中的重要数学模型，而完美态转移（PST）是实现量子态在量子网络中可靠传输的关键性质。此前对有向循环图中PST的完整刻画尚属空白，本文旨在对这一类图进行穷尽分类，填补理论空白。
AI.method: 利用有向循环图Hermitian邻接矩阵的Fourier特征值理论，通过奇原二次狄利克雷特征来描述图结构。推导了不需假设n/Δ与Δ互素的每个Fourier特征值的显式公式，并通过对特征值η_j满足的同余条件来确定所有PST对、时间、最小周期以及支持多重态转移（MST）的最大顶点集。对每个导子Δ∈{3,4,8}给出了连接集的充要条件。
AI.result: 证明PST仅发生于Δ∈{3,4,8}，即平方自由根号数仅可能为1、2、3；推导出所有Fourier特征值的显式公式；给出了每个导子下连接集的充要条件；证明在此图类中pretty good态转移等价于PST；确定了连通阶数并枚举了所有满足条件的图。
AI.conclusion: 完成了对有向循环图中完美态转移的完整分类，给出了精确的充要条件与显式构造，为量子网络中的态传输设计提供了理论依据。

title: Contextuality in the $n$-qubit Pauli group
summary:
The $n$-qubit Pauli group is an essential ingredient to most quantum applications, from computing and error correction to benchmarking and simulation. Despite comprising merely a discrete set of operators, it exhibits many quintessential features of quantum theory, including contextuality, which has been identified as a key resource to quantum advantage in a variety of different flavours. Here, we extend this analysis, introducing the notion of a `noncontextual property' whose nonexistence proves the Kochen-Specker theorem, similarly to and generalising common arguments based on the nonexistence of valuations. We relate this notion formally to the existence of Boolean-valued frame functions, and characterise all such frame functions in the case of the $n$-qubit Pauli group.
  For two qubits, we show that the Pauli group admits noncontextual properties, despite admitting no valuations. We then establish this as the only nontrivial such case with $n\geq 2$, by proving that any Boolean-valued frame function on stabiliser states is constant for more than two qubits. We also perform a similar analysis for the symplectic theory underlying the $n$-qubit Pauli group, for which nonconstant Boolean-valued frame functions exist for all $n$, yet only in restricted form. By comparison, this shows that contextuality in the $n$-qubit Pauli group is not only a consequence of the projective nature of the Pauli group as a representation of its underlying symplectic vector space, but of the geometry of symplectic polar spaces itself. In geometric terms, our result determines all Cameron-Liebler sets of maximal totally isotropic flats in the binary affine-symplectic space.

AI.tldr: 本文研究n量子比特Pauli群的语境性（contextuality），引入"非语境性质"概念，将其与布尔值框架函数的存在性联系起来，并完整刻画了这一函数。文章证明两量子比特Pauli群存在非语境性质却不存在估值，而多于两量子比特时这种性质消失；同时分析了底层辛几何理论，揭示语境性不仅源于Pauli群的射影表征性质，更源于辛极空间本身的几何结构。
AI.motivation: Pauli群是量子计算、纠错、基准测试和模拟等绝大多数量子应用的核心成分。尽管它仅是离散算子集合，却展现出量子理论的许多典型特征，包括语境性——这已被认为是多种量子优势的关键资源。本文旨在深化对n量子比特Pauli群中语境性的理解，通过引入"非语境性质"这一新概念，将其与Kochen-Specker定理、估值和框架函数等经典工具联系起来，从而从更几何的角度揭示语境性的本质来源。
AI.method: 本文引入"非语境性质"（noncontextual property）概念，其不存在性可证明Kochen-Specker定理，是对基于估值不存在性论证的推广。该概念与布尔值框架函数（Boolean-valued frame functions）的存在性在形式上建立了联系，并完整刻画了n量子比特Pauli群上所有此类框架函数。具体地，对两量子比特情形证明Pauli群有非语境性质但无估值；对n≥2的更一般情形，证明多于两量子比特时稳定子上任何布尔值框架函数必为常数。此外，对Pauli群背后的辛理论做了类似分析，确定了二进制仿射辛空间中极大全迷向平直子空间的Cameron-Liebler集。
AI.result: 两量子比特Pauli群承认非语境性质，尽管其不承认任何估值，且这是n≥2时唯一非平凡的情形。对于n>2，任何定义在稳定子态上的布尔值框架函数必为常数。在底层的辛理论层面，非恒定布尔值框架函数对所有n都存在，但仅以受限形式出现。这一对比表明，n量子比特Pauli群的语境性不仅是Pauli群作为其底层辛向量空间表示的射影性质的后果，更源于辛极空间本身的几何结构。在几何上，结果等价于确定了二进制仿射辛空间中所有极大全迷向平直子空间的Cameron-Liebler集。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入"非语境性质"和布尔值框架函数，深化了对n量子比特Pauli群语境性的认识。两量子比特情形是唯一允许非平凡非语境性质的情形；多于两量子比特时，语境性更强地扎根于底层辛极空间的几何中，而非仅源于射影表征。这揭示了Pauli群语境性的几何本质，并将问题与Cameron-Liebler集的分类相联系，为理解量子语境性的结构来源提供了新的视角。

title: Efficient Assembly of a Defect-Free Quantum Register of 1024 Neutral-Atom Qubits
summary: Low-entropy arrays of atomic quantum systems in optical tweezers offer unique prospects for fundamental research on few- and many-body systems as well as for extended applications in quantum technology. The significance of this approach relies on the achievable system size, its uniformity, and the rate of qubit allocation. We propel the neutral-atom quantum-technology platform by the rapid assembly of a regular two-dimensional quantum register of up to 1024 atomic qubits, enabled by a novel implementation of intensity-homogenized tweezer arrays and parallelized atom transport. Our highly efficient microoptical architecture modularizes intensity equalization and tweezer patterning in separate functional units, eliminating restrictions that arise for high-power, high-resolution, and large-scale light-field control within a single device. Arrays of precise grid structure, trap depth, and vibrational frequency with more than 3500 sites are demonstrated. Individual sites are interconnected by up to 50 parallelized transport tweezers with intensity and position control in real-time for swift qubit relocation. Multi-tweezer transport enables the operation of target patterns of up to 32 x 32 sites with sustained near-unity filling fraction. These results boost neutral-atom quantum information science above the kiloqubit level.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了在中性原子量子技术平台上实现快速组装最多1024个原子量子比特的二维规则量子寄存器的突破性工作，通过强度均匀化光镊阵列和并行原子输运技术，将系统规模提升至千量子比特以上。
AI.motivation: 低熵原子量子系统阵列在基础物理研究（少体与多体系统）以及量子技术应用中具有独特前景，其价值取决于可实现的系统规模、均匀性以及量子比特分配速率。现有技术在高功率、高分辨率和大规模光场控制方面存在单一设备限制，迫切需要新架构突破这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种新型微光学架构，将强度均匀化与光镊构图分离为独立功能模块，消除单器件中高功率、高分辨率和大型光场控制之间的相互制约。采用并行化原子输运光镊（多达50个实时强度与位置可控的输运镊），实现快速量子比特重排，并演示了超过3500个具有精确栅格结构、阱深和振动频率的阵列位点。
AI.result: 成功实现最多1024个（32×32）原子量子比特的规则二维量子寄存器，以接近单位填充率运行。阵列规模超过3500个位点，量子比特分配通过50个并行输运光镊实现，兼具强度与位置实时控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将中性原子量子信息科学推升至千量子比特水平，为中性原子量子计算与量子模拟的大规模扩展提供了可行路径，标志着中性原子平台迈入kiloqubit时代。

title: Design of monolithic microcavities for enhancing organic quantum emitters
summary: Single organic molecules are a well-established platform for high-quality single-photon generation: they can emit lifetime-limited photons with high purity and indistinguishability. However, their emission is accompanied by a pronounced red-shifted phonon sideband and higher-order vibrational peaks, which reduce the fraction of photons emitted into the desired narrowband zero-phonon line. The standard approach to suppressing this unwanted emission is to integrate the emitter into a monolithic photonic nanostructure that provides Purcell enhancement. However, incorporating organic materials using clean-room techniques has proven challenging, and has in fact so far prevented their integration into monolithic microcavities altogether. As a result, efficient, narrowband organic single-photon sources for applications in quantum information processing have remained elusive despite their considerable promise. Here, we propose three monolithic microcavity designs tailored to provide sufficient Purcell enhancement for organic quantum emitters. The Purcell effect induced by these cavities preferentially enhances emission into the 0-0 zero-phonon line, increasing spectral purity, photon extraction, and shortening the excited-state lifetime, which in turn relaxes the requirements for generating indistinguishable photons. The cavities have been optimized using Bayesian optimization and the adaptive Antoulas-Anderson (AAA) algorithm for rational approximation, which offer global optimization and the efficient reconstruction of spectra from scattering simulations, respectively. These structures are compatible with both standard clean-room processing and single-molecule preparation techniques. Therefore, they offer a clear route to realize high-quality, practically monochromatic organic single-photon light sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种单片式微腔设计，用于增强有机量子发射体的Purcell效应，从而抑制声子边带发射、提高零声子线（ZPL）的光谱纯度、光子提取效率和激发态寿命缩短，为高效窄带有机单光子源提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: 有机单分子是优异的单光子发射平台，但其发射伴随红移的声子边带和振动峰，降低了零声子线的光子比例。传统方案是通过单片光子纳米结构提供Purcell增强来抑制非期望发射，但有机材料难以通过洁净室工艺集成，此前一直未能实现单片微腔集成，导致高效窄带有机单光子源迟迟未能实现。
AI.method: 提出三种单片式微腔设计，针对有机量子发射体提供足够的Purcell增强。利用贝叶斯优化进行全局优化，并采用自适应Antoulas-Anderson（AAA）算法进行有理逼近，以从散射模拟中高效重构光谱。这些结构兼容标准洁净室工艺和单分子制备技术。
AI.result: 三种微腔设计能够优先增强0-0零声子线发射，提高光谱纯度、增加光子提取效率，并缩短激发态寿命，从而降低产生不可区分光子的要求。微腔通过贝叶斯优化和AAA算法优化，实现了全局寻优和高效光谱重构。
AI.conclusion: 这些微腔结构与现有洁净室加工和单分子制备技术均兼容，为实际实现高质量、近乎单色的有机单光子光源提供了清晰的技术路线。

title: The Min-Rains Relative Entropy Is Not Tight for Exact PPT Entanglement Distillation
summary: Exact entanglement distillation converts a noisy bipartite state into a maximally entangled state with zero error. Under completely PPT-preserving operations, the additive min-Rains relative entropy provides a single-letter upper bound on the regularized distillation rate. An interesting problem in entanglement theory dating back to 2016 has been whether this bound is always tight. Here we resolve this question in the negative. The key is a tensor-stable rigidity absent from the min-Rains relaxation: every feasible exact-distillation effect must act as the identity on the support of the input state. We convert this constraint into a new single-letter upper bound using a generally non-Hermitian, range-supported witness. For a rank-three subspace, we show this upper bound lies strictly below the min-Rains relative entropy for every state with that support. Thus, the constraint discarded by the min-Rains relaxation remains relevant under arbitrary tensor powers. Our result rules out the min-Rains relative entropy as a closed-form formula for exact PPT distillable entanglement and reveals the subtle asymptotic structure of exact entanglement manipulation under PPT operations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个可追溯到2016年的开放问题：min-Rains相对熵作为精确PPT蒸馏率的单字母上界并非总是紧的。关键在于精确蒸馏效应必须在输入态支撑上恒等，这一张量稳定的刚性约束被min-Rains松弛所忽略。通过构造一个非厄米的range-supported见证，作者对秩三子空间证明了新上界严格低于min-Rains相对熵，从而否定了该量作为精确PPT可蒸馏纠缠度的闭式公式。
AI.motivation: 纠缠蒸馏是量子信息理论的核心问题之一。自2016年以来，一个悬而未决的开放问题是：在完全保PPT（正部分转置）操作下，加性min-Rains相对熵给出的单字母上界是否总是紧的（即等于精确蒸馏率）。解决这一问题对于理解PPT操作下精确纠缠操纵的渐近结构至关重要。
AI.method: 作者首先识别出一个关键的张量稳定刚性性质：任何可行的精确蒸馏效应必须在其输入态支撑上恒等作用。这一约束是min-Rains相对熵松弛所遗漏的。作者将这一约束转化为一个新的单字母上界，利用一个一般非厄米、range-supported的见证算子。他们构建了一个特定的秩三子空间，并在此子空间上证明了新上界严格低于min-Rains相对熵。
AI.result: 对于秩三子空间，作者证明了新构造的上界对具有该支撑的每个态都严格低于min-Rains相对熵。由于该约束在任意张量幂下仍然相关，这排除了min-Rains相对熵作为精确PPT可蒸馏纠缠度的闭式公式的可能性。
AI.conclusion: min-Rains相对熵不是精确PPT蒸馏率的紧上界，解决了2016年以来的开放问题。该工作揭示了精确纠缠操纵在PPT操作下的微妙渐近结构，表明被松弛掉的结构约束（如张量稳定的刚性）在渐近极限下依然不可忽视。

title: Floquet-Resolved Dissipation Selects Entanglement Beyond Population Spectroscopy
summary: Reliable quantum-state engineering in periodically driven devices requires more than reproducing their excitation spectrum: the environment must resolve the transitions of the driven system. We show that two dissipative descriptions of the same parametrically coupled qubits can yield closely similar period-averaged populations yet qualitatively different asymptotic entanglement. Both retain the complete periodically driven Hamiltonian, the same microscopic bath couplings, and the same physical observables; they differ in the dynamical representation used to resolve the dissipative channels and the corresponding system operators: the static dressed basis in the partial harmonic decomposition approach (PHDA) and the Floquet basis, including all relevant drive sidebands, in Floquet-Born-Markov (FBM) theory. The population maps preserve the same resonance skeleton and remain closely similar over broad low-to-moderate drive regions, while clearer differences emerge as the modulation becomes stronger. Phase-resolved single- and two-qubit coherence observables reveal a substantially stronger redistribution of amplitudes and phases. Concurrence amplifies this hidden state-level discrepancy: Floquet-resolved dissipation selects stronger and more extended Bell-like entangled regions and a larger overlap with a fixed Bell-like reference, while PHDA generally underestimates the entanglement and its thermal persistence. A channel-resolution test verifies the secular, completely positive FBM construction throughout the relevant parameter domain. Our results establish population agreement as an insufficient benchmark for open Floquet quantum-state engineering and identify coherence-sensitive observables as the decisive validation test.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在周期性驱动的量子系统中，仅重现激发谱或周期平均布居数不足以保证可靠的量子态工程；环境必须正确分辨驱动系统的跃迁。通过对比两种相同的参数耦合量子比特耗散描述（PHDA与FBM），发现两者周期平均布居数高度相似但渐近纠缠定性不同。布居数吻合不能作为开放Floquet量子态工程的充分基准，相干敏感观测量才是决定性验证标准。
AI.motivation: 周期性驱动器件中的可靠量子态工程需要环境能够分辨驱动系统的跃迁，而不仅仅是重现其激发谱。已有方法（如PHDA）可能在某些观测量上给出看似正确的预测，但可能在纠缠等更敏感的量子资源上产生误导性结果。作者旨在揭示不同耗散描述框架之间隐藏的状态级差异，建立更严格的验证基准。
AI.method: 在完全保留周期驱动哈密顿量、相同微观浴耦合和相同物理可观测量前提下，比较两种耗散描述框架：一是基于静态缀饰基矢的偏谐波分解方法（PHDA），二是包含所有相关驱动边带的Floquet-Born-Markov（FBM）理论。对参数耦合量子比特系统进行布居数、相位分辨相干和并发度的系统性对比分析，并通过通道分辨测试验证FBM构造的世俗性与完全正定性。
AI.result: 两种方法的周期平均布居数图在低至中等驱动区域保持紧密相似且共享相同的共振骨架，但驱动增强时差异显现。相位分辨的单量子比特和双量子比特相干观测量揭示出更显著的振幅和相位重分布。并发度放大了这种隐藏的状态级差异：Floquet分辨耗散产生更强、更广的Bell类纠缠区域，以及与固定Bell类参考态更大的重叠，而PHDA普遍低估纠缠及其热持续性。通道分辨测试证实FBM在整个相关参数域内保持世俗、完全正定。
AI.conclusion: 布居数的吻合不足以作为开放Floquet量子态工程的验证基准。耗散通道的动力学表示（缀饰基 vs Floquet基）选择对纠缠等量子资源具有定性影响。相干敏感观测量（如相位分辨相干和并发度）被确立为区分不同耗散描述框架的决定性验证工具。

title: Parity Mapping for Quantum Optimization on Frustrated Ising Rings
summary: The frustrated Ising ring is one of the simplest models exhibiting exponential closing spectral gaps, making it a paradigmatic and challenging benchmark for quantum annealing (QA). Ground-state preparation for this model has therefore been studied extensively in both continuous-time QA and digitized protocols such as the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). Here, we use the frustrated Ising ring to investigate how the parity mapping affects the performance of both QA and QAOA. For QA, finite-size calculations show that the parity mapping increases the minimum spectral gap under the energy normalization used in this work, thereby enabling faster continuous-time ground state preparation protocols. An ideal implementation of Parity-QA, with a single global constraint, shows no evidence of exponential gap closing over the accessible system sizes, whereas a hardware-motivated decomposition into local constraints restores the exponential decrease, albeit with a smaller fitted exponent than conventional QA. For the digitized protocol, we find that the number of Parity-QAOA layers required to prepare the exact ground state remains constant over the simulated sizes, improving upon the quadratic scaling required by conventional QAOA. To investigate the role of constraints in Parity-QAOA, we further consider a modified Ising ring instance in which the constraint term is essential for preparing the target ground state. We then compare the corresponding resource requirements with those of conventional QAOA.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了parity映射（奇偶映射）如何影响量子退火（QA）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在受挫Ising环上的表现。结果表明，parity映射在能量归一化下增大了QA的最小谱隙，且理想全局约束的Parity-QA未显示指数级谱隙闭合；硬件局部分解则恢复指数衰减但指数更小。Parity-QAOA的层数在模拟尺寸内保持恒定，优于传统QAOA的二次方标度。
AI.motivation: 受挫Ising环是最简单的展现指数级谱隙闭合的模型之一，是量子退火的经典基准。此前对基态制备的研究多在传统QA和QAOA框架下进行，而parity映射（将问题映射到更高维空间并引入约束）对QA和QAOA性能的影响尚不明确，因此需要系统研究。
AI.method: 在受挫Ising环上分别对比连续时间QA和数字化QAOA在原始映射与parity映射下的表现。QA方面进行有限尺寸计算最小谱隙（采用能量归一化），并区分理想全局约束与硬件启发的局域约束分解两种实现；QAOA方面统计精确制备基态所需的层数，并额外构造约束项至关重要的修改版Ising环实例以研究约束的作用。
AI.result: parity映射在能量归一化下增大了最小谱隙，使连续时间基态制备更快。理想全局约束的Parity-QA在可及系统尺寸内未出现指数级谱隙闭合，而局域约束分解会恢复指数衰减但拟合指数小于传统QA。Parity-QAOA制备精确基态所需层数在模拟尺寸内保持常数，而传统QAOA需要二次方级层数。
AI.conclusion: parity映射能够显著提升受挫Ising环上QA和QAOA的基态制备效率，尤其在理想全局约束条件下可避免指数级谱隙闭合；即便在硬件局域约束分解下，指数衰减也有所缓解。Parity-QAOA的常数层级缩放优于传统QAOA的二次方缩放，表明parity映射对量子优化协议具有普遍性能优势。

title: Capability-Adaptive Cryptanalysis with Reduced-Space Quantum Verification
summary: Efficient integration of cryptanalytic evidence with quantum verification remains a fundamental challenge in hybrid classical-quantum cryptanalysis. This work presents a capability-adaptive cryptanalytic framework that unifies linear cryptanalysis, differential cryptanalysis, and side-channel leakage analysis within a common candidate-space reduction architecture, followed by reduced-space quantum verification through amplitude amplification. A formal mathematical model is developed for candidate-space construction, adaptive filtering, verification-space reduction, and complexity characterization, supported by the oretical results establishing the relationship between candidate-space contraction and quantum verification effort. A Hamiltonian formulation is further introduced to provide a physically realizable interpretation of the reduced-space verification process. Evaluation using statistically generated cryptanalytic observations demonstrates that the proposed framework reduces an initial candidate-key hypothesis space of 4096 candidates to an effective candidate space of 13 hypotheses, corresponding to an overall reduction of approximately 99.683%. Consequently, the Grover verification requirement decreases from 50 iterations to only 2 iterations, yielding an approximately 25-fold reduction in verification effort, while reduced-space amplitude amplification achieves a target-state success probability of approximately 94.53%. These results demonstrate that adaptive cryptanalytic filtering can substantially reduce quantum verification complexity while preserving cryptanalytic admissibility, providing a practical foundation for capability-aware hybrid cryptanalysis and reduced-space quantum search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种能力自适应的密码分析框架，将线性密码分析、差分密码分析和侧信道泄漏分析统一到候选空间约减架构中，再通过振幅放大进行约减空间量子验证。实验表明，候选密钥假设空间从4096降至13个（约99.683%的缩减），Grover验证迭代次数从50减至2（约25倍验证效率提升），目标态成功概率约94.53%。
AI.motivation: 混合经典-量子密码分析中，如何高效地将经典密码分析证据与量子验证进行集成仍是一个根本性挑战。
AI.method: 构建统一的候选空间约减架构，融合线性密码分析、差分密码分析和侧信道泄漏分析；建立候选空间构造、自适应过滤、验证空间约减与复杂度表征的形式化数学模型；引入哈密顿量公式化描述以提供约减空间验证过程的物理可实现解释；采用振幅放大完成约减空间的量子验证。
AI.result: 候选密钥假设空间从4096降至13，缩减约99.683%；Grover验证迭代次数从50降至2，约25倍的验证努力缩减；约减空间振幅放大的目标态成功概率约94.53%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应密码分析过滤能够在保持密码分析可容许性的前提下显著降低量子验证复杂度，为能力感知的混合密码分析与约减空间量子搜索提供了实用基础。

title: Isospectral majorization and isoperimetric inequalities for coherent states on the Bloch sphere
summary:
Let $\mathcal{P}_{N}$ be the $(N+1)$-dimensional Hilbert space of analytic polynomials of degree at most $N$. This is the natural environment to define $SU(2)$ (Bloch) coherent states. Let $Q_{ρ}$ be the Husimi function of a density operator $ρ$ on $% \mathcal{P}_{N}$. We prove an isospectral version of Lieb-Solovej inequality: if $ρ^{\downarrow }$ is obtained by placing the eigenvalues of $ρ$ in decreasing order along the monomial basis, then \begin{equation*} \int_{\mathbb{C}}Φ(Q_{ρ}(z))\,dm(z)\leq \int_{\mathbb{C}}Φ(Q_{ρ^{\downarrow }}(z))\,dm(z) \end{equation*}% for every convex function $Φ$ on $[0,1]$. Applying the corresponding reversed inequality to the concave function $Φ(t)=-t\log t$ gives the Wehrl entropy. In the process it is show that the output state of $ρ$ under Lieb-Solovej's channel is majorized by the output of the state $ρ^{\downarrow }$.
  As an application, among all measurable subsets of the sphere having a fixed area, spherical caps maximize every partial sum of the eigenvalues of Toeplitz operators with symbol $1_Ω$. Equivalently, caps maximize all Ky Fan norms, leading to the sharp inequalities, previously known for $r=1$: \begin{equation*} \sum_{j=1}^{r}λ_{j}(Ω) \leq r-\sum_{k=0}^{r-1}(r-k)\binom{N+1}{k} m(Ω)^{k}\bigl(1-m(Ω)\bigr)^{N+1-k}. \end{equation*} This implies isoperimetric inequalities for all Schatten sums of $T_Ω$, obtained without using the spherical isoperimetric inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文在解析多项式构成的(N+1)维Hilbert空间上，证明了Lieb-Solovej不等式的等谱版本：将密度算子的特征值按递减顺序沿单项式基重新排列后，对任意凸函数Φ，Husimi函数的积分不变式成立。作为应用，该结果推导出球面上固定面积的测度子集中，球冠最大化Toeplitz算子特征值的所有部分和（即所有Ky Fan范数），从而得到所有Schatten和的等周不等式。
AI.motivation: 经典Lieb-Solovej不等式涉及SU(2)相干态和Husimi函数，但原始版本仅适用于特定符号函数。作者希望证明一个更强的等谱版本——即特征值的递减重排（沿单项式基）会使所有凸函数的Husimi函数积分增大，从而统一并推广已有结果，并用于证明Toeplitz算子的等周型不等式。
AI.method: 核心思想是考虑Lieb-Solovej通道：将密度算子映射为其沿单项式基对角化后的输出态。作者证明该通道的输出态被重排态ρ^↓的输出态所majorization（优超）。利用majorization理论，任意凸函数Φ的积分不等式随之成立；对凹函数Φ(t)=-t log t应用反向不等式即得Wehrl熵。在几何应用部分，利用上述分析不等式将Toeplitz算子符号指标函数1_Ω的特征值部分和问题化为球冠情形的优化问题。
AI.result: 证明了以下内容：(1) 等谱Lieb-Solovej不等式：对任意凸函数Φ，∫Φ(Q_ρ)dm ≤ ∫Φ(Q_{ρ^↓})dm；(2) 上述不等式蕴含Wehrl熵版本；(3) 在球面上，固定面积的子集中球冠最大化Toeplitz算子T_Ω的每个特征值部分和（即所有Ky Fan范数），得到r阶Ky Fan范数的显式尖锐不等式；(4) 由此推导出所有Schatten和的等周不等式，且不依赖球形等周不等式。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了等谱Lieb-Solovej不等式这一强有力的分析工具，它不仅推广了经典结果，还通过majorization技术将函数空间中的特征值估计转化为球面上的几何优化问题，最终得到Toeplitz算子特征值和Schatten范数的锐利等周不等式，且证明方法独立于经典的球形等周不等式。

title: A Unified Quantum Interferometric Framework for Interaction-Free Measurement and Delayed-Choice Experiments
comment: A theoretical unified interferometric framework is developed for interaction-free measurement (IFM) and delayed-choice (DC) experiments
summary: A theoretical unified interferometric framework is developed for interaction-free measurement (IFM) and delayed-choice (DC) experiments. The proposed model leads to a quantum circuit based architecture in which an ancillary qubit coherently controls the interaction between a photon and a bomb, allowing the system to evolve in a superposition of interaction and non-interaction regimes. The ancillary control qubit serves as a quantum switch that continuously interpolates between IFM and DC behavior, revealing a common operational origin for both phenomena. We demonstrate that both the phenomena can be realized within this framework through controlled quantum-gate operations. The analysis shows that the framework enables a continuous transition between the particle-like and wave-like behavior in DC setup. The framework is shown to be consistent with standard quantum mechanics, preserving unitary evolution, quantum superposition and the measurement postulate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论干涉测量框架，用于描述相互作用-free测量（IFM）和延迟选择（DC）实验。该框架基于量子电路架构，通过辅助比特相干控制光子与炸弹之间的相互作用，使系统在相互作用和非相互作用叠加态中演化，揭示了两种现象的公共操作性起源。
AI.motivation: IFM和DC实验虽然表面上属于不同的量子现象，但可能具有共同的理论基础。作者旨在建立一个统一的干涉测量框架，从操作层面揭示这两类现象的共性，并通过量子电路实现连续过渡。
AI.method: 提出量子电路架构，其中辅助控制比特作为量子开关，相干控制光子与炸弹的相互作用，使系统处于相互作用/非相互作用叠加态。通过受控量子门操作在统一框架内实现IFM和DC两种现象，并分析其在DC实验中粒子性与波动性之间的连续转变。
AI.result: 统一框架成功实现了IFM和DC两种现象，支持DC设置中粒子性与波动性之间的连续转变，且与标准量子力学保持一致，保持幺正演化、量子叠加和测量公设。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的理论框架能够统一解释IFM和DC实验，两者的公共操作起源可通过辅助量子比特的相干控制来实现，为量子信息处理中的干涉测量提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Eigenstate Preparation Through Near-Optimal Eigenprobability Filtering
summary: Quantum simulation is expected to be a main application of quantum computers with realistic utility in quantum chemistry, materials science and beyond. However, preparing excited or general eigenstates is a central challenge, particularly when the desired eigenvalue is not known in advance, or when the overlap with the initial state is insufficient. We introduce the Dominant Eigenstate Filtering via Eigenprobability Amplification and Thresholding (DEFEAT) algorithm that identifies and filters the eigenstate with the largest overlap with the supplied initial state. Our key observation is that we do not need prior knowledge of the target eigenvalue, as we construct efficient twirling superoperators that map initial states to eigenprobability density operators $ρ$, diagonal in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis and encoding its spectral weights, alongside its block-encoding implementation. Our crucial innovation is the quadratic amplification of probabilities via the factorisation $ρ=ρ_{\rm sqrt}^\daggerρ_{\rm sqrt}$, analogous to the recently introduced sum-of-squares spectral amplification (SOSSA), which we use here to amplify the separation between dominant and subdominant components. Thresholding then yields the dominant-eigenstate projector. Compared with conventional phase estimation, DEFEAT improves the dependence on the overlap with the initial state while requiring substantially fewer ancillary qubits. We prove that the query complexity of the filtering step is optimal up to logarithmic factors and establish a complementary lower bound for eigenstate preparation under purified query access to $ρ$. We validate in numerical simulations that the convergence rate of DEFEAT matches our theoretical results. Our results provide a general eigenvalue-agnostic primitive for dominant eigenstate filtering and preparation, and for estimating properties of dominant eigenstates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEFEAT算法，一种无需预先知道特征值即可识别并筛选出与初始态重叠最大的本征态的量子算法，通过构造高效twirling超算符将初始态映射为哈密顿量本征基下的对角密度算符，并利用ρ=ρ_sqrt†ρ_sqrt的因子分解实现概率的二次放大，通过阈值化得到主导本征态投影子，在查询复杂度和辅助量子比特数量上优于传统相位估计方法。
AI.motivation: 量子模拟是量子计算机的重要应用场景，但制备激发态或一般本征态是核心挑战，尤其是在目标特征值未知或初始态重叠不足的情况下。现有方法（如相位估计）对初始态重叠的依赖较强，且需要大量辅助量子比特。因此需要一种特征值无关、更高效的主导本征态过滤算法。
AI.method: DECAD算法包含两个关键创新：1) 构造高效twirling超算符，将初始态映射为本征概率密度算符ρ（在哈密顿量本征基下对角且编码谱权重），并给出其block-encoding实现；2) 通过因子分解ρ=ρ_sqrt†ρ_sqrt实现主导与次主导分量之间分离度的二次放大（类似SOSSA），再通过阈值化得到主导本征态投影子。论文还证明了过滤步骤的查询复杂度在log因子意义下最优，并在受限查询访问ρ的条件下建立了本征态制备的下界。
AI.result: DEFEAT相比传统相位估计，改善了与初始态重叠的依赖关系，同时大幅减少所需辅助量子比特数量。过滤步骤的查询复杂度被证明在log因子意义下最优，且建立了互补的计算下界。数值模拟验证了算法的收敛速率与理论结果一致。
AI.conclusion: DEFEAT提供了一种通用的特征值无关的主导本征态过滤与制备原始工具，并可用于估计主导本征态的性质，为量子化学和材料科学中的量子模拟提供了实用潜力。

title: Quantum-limited imaging using diffractive optical neural networks
summary: We cast general imaging as multiparameter quantum estimation of band-limited spatial-frequency amplitudes. For separable (single-copy) measurements, we compute precision limits using semidefinite programming to evaluate the Nagaoka-Hayashi Cramér-Rao bound. We then introduce an architecture for a measurement apparatus based on diffractive optical neural networks and photon counting that saturates this bound. Extending the framework to arbitrary objects and many amplitudes, we show image reconstructions in which our architecture recovers fine features at the quantum limit, outperforming direct imaging. Together, these results open a scalable route to saturating multiparameter quantum limits in superresolution microscopy, telescopy, and remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文将一般成像问题转化为带限空间频率振幅的多参数量子估计问题，利用半定规划评估Nagaoka-Hayashi Cramér-Rao界给出可分测量下的精度极限，并引入基于衍射光学神经网络与光子计数的测量架构来饱和该界限，在任意物体和多振幅场景下实现超越直接成像的量子极限图像重建。
AI.motivation: 直接成像在超分辨显微镜、望远镜和遥感等应用中受限于经典测量精度，需要建立可饱和多参数量子估计极限的通用框架与可扩展的实际测量架构，以突破经典成像的精度瓶颈。
AI.method: 将成像建模为带限空间频率振幅的多参数量子估计；对可分(单拷贝)测量使用半定规划求解Nagaoka-Hayashi Cramér-Rao界以计算精度极限；提出基于衍射光学神经网络和光子计数的测量装置架构，用于饱和该量子界限。
AI.result: 所提出的架构能饱和Nagaoka-Hayashi Cramér-Rao界；推广到任意物体和多振幅场景后，图像重建能在量子极限下恢复精细特征，性能优于直接成像。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在超分辨显微镜、望远镜和遥感中饱和多参数量子极限提供了可扩展的路径，将量子估计理论从理论界限推进到实际可实现的成像系统。

title: Learning to Coordinate via Quantum Entanglement in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: The inability to communicate poses a major challenge to coordination in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Prior work has explored correlating local policies via shared randomness, sometimes in the form of a correlation device, as a mechanism to assist in decentralized decision-making. In contrast, this work introduces the first framework for training MARL agents to exploit shared quantum entanglement as a coordination resource, which permits a larger class of communication-free correlated policies than shared randomness alone. This is motivated by well-known results in quantum physics which posit that, for certain single-round cooperative games with no communication, shared quantum entanglement enables strategies that outperform those that only use shared randomness. In such cases, we say that there is quantum advantage. Our framework is based on a novel differentiable policy parameterization that enables optimization over quantum measurements, together with a novel policy architecture that decomposes joint policies into a quantum coordinator and decentralized local actors. To illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, we first show that we can learn, purely from experience, strategies that attain quantum advantage in single-round games that are treated as black box oracles. We then demonstrate how our machinery can learn policies with quantum advantage in an illustrative multi-agent sequential decision-making problem formulated as a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP).

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出利用共享量子纠缠作为协调资源的MARL训练框架，通过可微策略参数化和量子协调器+局部Actor的架构，使智能体学习在无通信条件下超越仅用共享随机性的相关策略，实现量子优势。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体强化学习中，无法通信是协调的主要挑战。已有工作利用共享随机性（相关设备）来辅助分散决策，但量子物理学表明，对某些单轮无通信合作博弈，共享量子纠缠能够实现超越仅使用共享随机性的策略（即量子优势），因此值得探索将量子纠缠作为MARL中的协调资源。
AI.method: 提出首个量子MARL训练框架：1) 设计一种新颖的可微策略参数化方法，使优化能够在量子测量空间上进行；2) 提出一种策略架构，将联合策略分解为量子协调器（quantum coordinator）和分散的局部Actor；3) 从纯经验驱动中学习策略。
AI.result: 在将单轮博弈视为黑盒oracle的场景中，可从经验中学习到获得量子优势的策略；在Dec-POMDP表示的示例性多智能体序列决策问题中，也能学习到具有量子优势的策略。
AI.conclusion: 共享量子纠缠可以作为一种有效的通信自由协调资源引入MARL，使可学习的策略超越共享随机性所能达到的相关策略性能上限，为在无通信约束下提升多智能体协调能力开辟了新路径。

title: Search for the Double Poles of the Scattering Matrix in Light Nuclei
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) are non-Hermitian degeneracies at which two eigenvalues and their eigenvectors coalesce, producing a defective Hamiltonian and a double pole of the $S$-matrix. Using the coupled-channel Gamow Shell Model with the $\ell=1$ spin-orbit strengths as control parameters, we locate and characterize EPs in $^6\text{Li}$, $^7\text{Li}$, $^7\text{Be}$, and $^8\text{Be}$, and analyze their imprint on energies, widths, phase rigidity, spectroscopic factors, elastic cross sections, survival probabilities, and spectral functions. The signatures of the EP in scattering and time-domain observables are found to be strongly channel-dependent, and threshold effects play a decisive role in determining the accessibility of the EP in parameter space.

AI.tldr: 本文利用耦合道Gamow壳模型，以l=1自旋轨道强度为控制参数，在^6Li、^7Li、^7Be和^8Be中定位并刻画了例外点（EP），并系统分析了其对能量、宽度、相位刚性、谱因子、弹性散射截面、存活概率和谱函数等可观测量印记，发现EP在散射和时域中的信号强烈依赖通道，且阈值效应决定EP在参数空间中的可达性。
AI.motivation: 例外点作为非厄米简并点，其特征在开放量子系统（如原子核）中的表现尚未被充分研究。理解EP对核结构和反应可观测量（尤其是散射与时间演化）的影响，有助于揭示非厄米效应在核物理中的作用，并为在真实核系统中探测EP提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用耦合道Gamow壳模型，以l=1自旋轨道耦合强度作为控制参数，通过扫描参数空间定位例外点，并计算能量、宽度、相位刚性、谱因子、弹性散射截面、存活概率和谱函数等观测量来分析EP的物理印记。
AI.result: 在四种轻核系统中成功定位了例外点，发现EP在散射截面和时域可观测量（如存活概率）中的特征签名强烈依赖于具体散射通道；同时，阈值效应显著影响EP在参数空间中被探测到的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 例外点对原子核可观测量的影响具有通道依赖性，阈值效应是决定EP可及性的关键因素。该研究为在真实核系统中识别和利用例外点提供了系统的理论框架和可观测判据。

title: A Quantum Circuit Framework for Protein Ensemble-Level Energetics
comment: Please see github repo https://github.com/pra-ashok/QProtSim for code and supplementary information. A Pypi package qprotsim is also available at https://pypi.org/project/qprotsim/
summary: Proteins occupy heterogeneous free-energy landscapes in which high-entropy ensembles converge toward compact, low-energy basins with multiple sub-states. Molecular dynamics can access these landscapes at atomic resolution, but exhaustive sampling remains computationally demanding. Meanwhile, most quantum approaches target only single optimal structures, leaving full ensemble energetic heterogeneity unexplored. We introduce a residue-level, gate-based quantum circuit framework for coarse-graining protein thermodynamics. Each amino acid is represented as a two-state qubit (stabilised vs. excited solvation state) based on residue solvation energetics. A structure-informed entanglement block then encodes covalent and non-covalent contacts using parameterised controlled gates, embedding correlations across the residue-interaction network. Sampling the circuit ($\sim 10^6$ measurements) yields binary thermodynamic microstates used to compute protein energy distributions, residue-level statistical couplings, energetic sensitivities, and information gains relative to total free energy. We showcase the framework on the benchmark Trp-cage miniprotein 1L2Y (TC5b) and 9GDL, a disulfide-stabilised Trp-cage-fortified exenatide chimera. For 1L2Y, the circuit reproduces a structured, folding-funnel-like energy distribution. Comparative analysis with 9GDL reveals shifts in global energy distributions and residue-level stability profiles. Coupling and information-theoretic analyses localise residues associated with ensemble reorganisation, while multi-body couplings show the circuit resolves both direct and indirect statistical correlations. This framework expands quantum protein modelling beyond single-structure optimisation toward ensemble-level characterisation, capturing key features of rugged energy landscapes to guide protein design, mutation mapping, and allosteric pathway identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于残基级门控量子电路的框架，用于蛋白质热力学的粗粒化模拟。每个氨基酸被编码为两态量子比特（稳定vs激发溶剂化态），通过结构信息化的纠缠块编码共价/非共价接触，对电路采样得到二值热力学微态，进而计算蛋白质能量分布、残基统计耦合、能量敏感性和信息增益。在1L2Y（Trp-cage）和9GDL（二硫键稳定的Trp-cage强化exenatide嵌合体）两种基准蛋白上验证，电路重现了折叠漏斗状能量分布，并能定位ensemble重组相关残基及多体耦合关系，将量子蛋白建模从单结构优化拓展至ensemble级表征。
AI.motivation: 传统分子动力学模拟虽能以原子分辨率探索蛋白质自由能景观，但穷举采样计算代价极高；而绝大多数量子计算方法仅针对单一最优结构，忽略了ensemble的异质性。现有的量子方法无法捕捉蛋白质能量景观中的多亚态结构和高熵ensemble信息，因此需要一种能够在量子框架下进行ensemble水平能量表征的方法。
AI.method: （1）以每个氨基酸为两态量子比特，基于残基溶剂化能量学区分"稳定态"与"激发态"；（2）构建结构信息化的纠缠块，用参数化受控门编码共价键和非共价接触，嵌入残基相互作用的关联；（3）对量子电路进行约10^6次测量采样，产生二值热力学微态；（4）从微态中计算蛋白质能量分布、残基级统计耦合、能量敏感性以及相对总自由能的信息增益。
AI.result: 在1L2Y（TC5b）上，电路成功重现了结构化折叠漏斗状能量分布；与9GDL的对比分析揭示了全局能量分布和残基稳定性的差异。耦合分析与信息论分析定位了与ensemble重组相关的残基，多体耦合分析表明电路能够解析直接和间接的统计相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将量子蛋白质建模从单一结构优化拓展到ensemble级表征，能够捕捉粗糙能量景观的关键特征，为蛋白质设计、突变图谱和变构通路识别提供指导。

title: How many labels can a biological oscillator carry? A quality-factor screen for proposed information carriers
comment: 20 pages, 7 tables, no figures. Reference implementation and verification suite at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21837368. Extends and supersedes doi:10.5281/zenodo.21837082
summary: How many distinguishable labels can a biological oscillator carry? Proposals invoking collective vibrational modes, endogenous electromagnetic fields, microtubule excitations and oscillatory phase codes are each debated on grounds particular to themselves, with no shared standard for comparison. We show that spectral distinguishability alone bounds the number of labels by the quality factor, M <= Q = 2 pi nu tau. This follows from the relation between linewidth and coherence time, so it is independent of substrate, of mechanism, and of any position on quantum effects in biology, and it can be evaluated from two published quantities. Applied to a recently proposed 30 GHz intracolumnar microwave field in cortex, it gives Q = 0.19: the linewidth exceeds the carrier five-fold. The obvious rescue, that a driven emitter can be spectrally narrower than its gain medium, requires a resonant cavity, and the model's own geometry forbids one. An independent bound on metabolic power is exceeded by five to nine orders of magnitude. Six further criteria follow from the same standpoint, including a two-sided persistence window requiring a label to be both readable and rewritable. Screening eleven carriers, only the low-frequency neural rhythms pass. High-frequency molecular carriers are eliminated by brevity, not by the fragility the debate has assumed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个普适的物理标准：任意生物振荡器可携带的可区分标签数量M受限于其品质因子Q=2πντ（由谱线和相干时间关系决定），与底物、机制及量子效应争论均无关。将该标准应用于近期提出的皮层30 GHz微波场载波时，发现其Q=0.19（线宽超过载频五倍），且代谢能量上限被超出5–9个数量级；额外六项判据进一步筛除十一种候选载波，仅低频神经节律通过。
AI.motivation: 关于生物振荡器能否携带多种可区分标签的争论（集体振动模式、内源电磁场、微管激发、振荡相位编码等）各有各的争议理由，缺乏统一比较标准。作者旨在建立一个与具体机制无关的通用上界，以客观评估不同候选载波的信息携带能力。
AI.method: 从谱线宽度与相干时间的基本关系出发，推导出光谱可区分性（spectral distinguishability）对标签数量M的约束：M ≤ Q = 2πντ。该界限完全由振荡频率ν和相干时间τ两个可发表的量决定，无需假设底物或机制。作者将该界限及额外六项判据（含"可读且可重写"的双向持久性窗口）应用于十一种候选生物载波逐一检验。
AI.result: 对皮层30 GHz微波场，计算得Q=0.19（线宽超过载频五倍），无法携带可区分标签；可能的技术性补救（谐振腔驱动使发射体谱线窄于增益介质）被模型自身几何排斥。该载波还超出代谢功率独立界限5–9个数量级。在十一种候选载波中，仅低频神经节律通过全部判据；高频分子载波因持续时间过短而被排除，而非先前争论所假设的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 生物系统中光谱信息携带能力存在由品质因子决定的普适上界，可作为跨机制公平比较的"公共标准"。所有高频分子/电磁载波因相干时间过短（Q过低）而无法通过，只有低频神经节律满足可读性和可重写性要求。这改变了争论的焦点：高频载波被排除的原因是生命周期短促，而非通常设想的脆弱性。

title: Particle Production, Equilibration, and Quantum Recurrences from Classical Fields
summary: We investigate particle production from classical fields, a phenomenon central to the pre-equilibrium dynamics of relativistic heavy-ion collisions and the reheating epoch of the early Universe. Using lattice $λφ^4$ theory as a proof of principle, we show that this problem is naturally amenable to quantum computation, providing a first-principles framework for nonequilibrium quantum-field dynamics beyond existing approximations. We perform simulations on small spatial lattices, exhausting our available classical computational resources while maintaining a direct mapping to future quantum-computing implementations. We find that particle production is accompanied by equilibration of observables, including the field expectation value, occupation-number distribution, and pressure. The observed equilibration persists for timescales several times longer than the initial equilibration time before the observables resume oscillatory behavior associated with quantum Poincaré recurrences. Our results establish a route toward first-principles studies of equilibration in nonequilibrium quantum field theory and provide insight into the search for the smallest possible locally equilibrated quark-gluon systems at hadron colliders.

AI.tldr: 本文以格点λφ⁴理论为原理验证，展示了粒子产生（pre-equilibrium动力学和宇宙再加热的核心现象）天然适用于量子计算。在小型空间格点上进行模拟，发现粒子产生伴随可观测量（场期望值、占据数分布、压强）的平衡化，该平衡化持续到初始平衡时间的数倍后才出现量子Poincaré回归的振荡行为。
AI.motivation: 相对论重离子碰撞的pre-equilibrium动力学和早期宇宙的再加热时期都涉及经典场的粒子产生，这一现象至今缺乏超越现有近似的第一性原理框架。作者希望利用量子计算从根本上解决非平衡量子场动力学问题，并为在强子对撞机中寻找最小可局域平衡的夸克-胶子系统提供洞见。
AI.method: 采用格点λφ⁴理论作为原理验证平台，通过量子计算框架对粒子产生过程进行模拟。在小空间格点上执行计算，在耗尽经典计算资源的同时保持与未来量子计算实现的直接映射关系。观测场期望值、占据数分布和压强等物理量的时间演化。
AI.result: 模拟表明粒子产生伴随可观测量（场期望值、占据数分布、压强）的平衡化。这种平衡化在初始平衡时间的数倍时间尺度内持续存在，随后可观测量由于量子Poincaré回归而恢复振荡行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非平衡量子场论中平衡化问题的第一性原理研究建立了可行路径，为未来量子计算在量子场论中的应用奠定了基础，并为在强子对撞机上寻找最小可局域平衡的夸克-胶子系统提供了新视角。

title: Dynamics of the spontaneous emission factor in multiple quantum well nanowire lasers
summary: The spontaneous emission factor - often known as the \b{eta} factor - is an important quantity in the description of quantum well lasers, influencing both the threshold power as well as the general shape of the light in-light out (L-L) curve. Past work on modelling multiple quantum well (MQW) nanowire laser devices has typically assumed that the \b{eta} factor is a constant parameter that can either be estimated or fit in a post-hoc manner. However, the \b{eta} factor can be derived from the transitions between valence and conduction bands in semiconductor quantum wells, together with knowledge of the cavity modes. Here we investigate the dynamic nature of the \b{eta} factor for MQW nanowire lasers, and show how it can be computed. We also examine the dependence of the spontaneous emission rate and spontaneous emission factor \b{eta} on the charge carrier density, quantum well thickness, and composition, and discuss the impact on laser threshold and operation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多量子阱（MQW）纳米线激光器中自发发射因子（η因子）的动态特性，指出以往工作常将其视为常数参数，而本文从半导体量子阱中价带与导带之间的跃迁以及腔模信息出发，推导并计算η因子，同时考察载流子密度、量子阱厚度和组分对自发发射速率及η因子的影响，并讨论其对激光阈值和运行的影响。
AI.motivation: 自发发射因子（η因子）是描述量子阱激光器的重要物理量，影响阈值功率和L-L曲线形状。然而以往对MQW纳米线激光器的建模通常将η因子视为可通过估计或事后拟合的常数参数，缺乏对其物理本质和动态变化特性的理解，因此需要从带间跃迁和腔模出发对其进行精确计算。
AI.method: 本文从半导体量子阱中价带与导带之间的跃迁出发，结合腔模信息，推导并计算MQW纳米线激光器的η因子；进一步系统分析自发发射速率和η因子对载流子密度、量子阱厚度及量子阱组分的依赖关系。
AI.result: 揭示了MQW纳米线激光器中η因子的动态本质，表明其并非恒定常数而是随工作条件变化的物理量；给出了η因子的计算方法，并阐明了自发发射速率和η因子随载流子密度、量子阱厚度及组分的变化规律，进一步讨论了这些变化对激光阈值和运行特性的影响。
AI.conclusion: MQW纳米线激光器的η因子具有动态特性，可通过带间跃迁与腔模信息精确计算，其对载流子密度、量子阱厚度和组分的依赖性深刻影响激光阈值和工作特性，为更准确的器件建模和设计提供了理论依据。

title: Scalar Finite-Proper-Time Field Theory as Spectral Operator Calculus
summary: We formulate a finite-proper-time construction for Euclidean scalar $λφ^4$ theory in which a retained endpoint $s_0$ is assigned to complete internal histories rather than independently to individual Schwinger segments. The theory is defined through paired open and closed spectral functions and their Fréchet/Duhamel hierarchy. Functional differentiation inserts operators along an existing proper-time history and partitions its total length, while interaction vertices sew separately complete histories. We introduce a corresponding complete-history diagrammatic calculus and derive the resulting one- and two-loop structures. We distinguish the retained endpoint from an auxiliary regulator or renormalisation-group scale and test whether its effects survive ordinary parameter matching and admissible field redefinitions. For the one-loop four-point function, fixing the renormalised mass, field normalisation, and quartic coupling leaves a finite momentum-dependent remainder. We establish a perturbative non-redundancy description of the retained endpoint against finite renormalisable-parameter redefinitions and local $S$-matrix-preserving field redefinitions at this order. The low-energy theory can be represented as an effective field theory, but its higher-derivative coefficients are not independent. This provides a concrete distinction between a retained finite proper-time scale and an arbitrary cutoff prescription.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种欧几里得标量λφ⁴理论的有限固有时构造，其中保留端点s₀被分配给完整的内部历史而非独立的Schwinger线段。通过配对的开/闭谱函数及其Fréchet/Duhamel层次定义理论，并建立相应的完整历史图式微积分。在单环四点函数中，固定重整化质量、场归一化和四次耦合后仍留下有限的动量依赖余项，表明该保留端点与普通截止方案在非冗余性上存在可区分的物理差异。
AI.motivation: 在量子场论中，固有时参数化中端点的处理通常将每个Schwinger线段独立分配端点，而本文探讨将单一保留端点分配给完整内部历史的替代构造。该工作的核心动机是区分"保留的有限固有时标度"与任意的截止/规整化方案：检验保留端点是否具有超越普通参数匹配和局部场重定义的物理可观测效应，从而为固有时方法提供更精确的概念基础。
AI.method: 作者采用配对的开/闭谱函数及其Fréchet/Duhamel层次结构定义理论；泛函微分沿已有固有时历史插入算子并划分其总长度，相互作用顶点独立缝合完整历史。引入相应的完整历史图式微积分，推导单环和双环结构。通过检验保留端点在有限可重整化参数重定义和保持S矩阵的局域场重定义下的非冗余性，以及低能有效场论中高阶导数系数是否独立来判断其物理意义。
AI.result: 对于单环四点函数，固定重整化质量、场归一化和四次耦合后仍剩余有限的动量依赖余项。保留端点对有限可重整化参数重定义和保持S矩阵的局域场重定义具有扰动非冗余性。低能理论可表示为有效场论，但其高阶导数系数并非独立——这与任意的截止规整化方案形成了具体区别。
AI.conclusion: 保留的有限固有时标度（保留端点）与任意截止规整化方案有本质区别：前者在单环四点函数中产生无法通过标准参数匹配和场重定义消除的有限动量依赖效应，且其低能有效场论的高阶导数系数受内在约束而非独立自由参数。这为固有时框架中"何为物理标度、何为规整化工具"提供了明确判据。

title: A uniform elliptic reduction, an order-matching criterion, and precision benchmarks for the strong-coupling Birman-Schwinger analysis of the lattice three-boson trimer
summary: We study the strong-coupling Birman-Schwinger analysis of the three-boson lattice Schroedinger operator at the exceptional quasimomentum K = pi. First, we provide an exact closed-form benchmark for the fiber Fredholm determinant at a distinguished flat momentum, valid for every quasimomentum K, obtained via a uniform elliptic reduction of the two-dimensional lattice integral. Second, we formulate and prove a general order-matching criterion. This criterion decides whether a leading-order Fredholm determinant asymptotic, with relative accuracy of order 1/mu, suffices to determine the constant-order additive correction in the strong-coupling energy, or if the next-order refinement is required. Applying the criterion at K = pi, we derive the complete strong-coupling ground-state asymptotics, including the coefficient of the order 1/mu term. The results are cross-validated against the exact closed-form benchmark and two independent high-precision numerical schemes. Furthermore, we determine the corresponding spectral gap and prove an exact Fredholm-determinant underestimation factor equal to 2. Additionally, we independently confirm that the previously established K = 0 constant is correctly derived and requires no analogous refinement. Finally, we compare the orders of asymptotic precision controlled across recent lattice few-body models and draw a structural parallel with the parity classification of topological band structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三维玻色格点薛定谔算子在奇异准动量K=π处强耦合Birman-Schwinger分析。作者给出精确闭式Fredholm行列式基准（适用于任意准动量K），提出并证明一般阶匹配准则，据此推导出K=π处的完整强耦合基态渐近展开（含1/μ阶系数），并通过闭式基准与两种高精度数值方案交叉验证。还确定了谱隙、证明了Fredholm行列式低估因子恒为2，并独立确认K=0常数无需细化修正，最后与近期格点多体模型的渐近精度阶数进行对比，并建立与拓扑能带结构宇称分类的结构性类比。
AI.motivation: 强耦合格点少体问题的渐近分析中，确定Fredholm行列式前导渐近是否足以获得能量常数阶修正是一个关键但未被严格解决的问题。在奇异准动量K=π处，由于格点积分的退化行为，需要更精细的阶匹配分析。本文旨在建立一般性判据，并给出该情形下完整的强耦合能量渐近。
AI.method: (1) 通过均匀椭圆约化将二维格点积分化为闭式Fredholm行列式基准；(2) 提出并证明一般阶匹配准则，判定前导渐近（相对精度1/μ量级）是否足以确定常数阶加性修正；(3) 将准则应用于奇异准动量K=π，推导完整强耦合基态渐近；(4) 用精确闭式基准和两种独立高精度数值方案交叉验证；(5) 证明Fredholm行列式低估因子恰为2，并独立复核K=0情形。
AI.result: (1) 获得了适用于任意准动量K的精确闭式Fredholm行列式基准；(2) 建立了判定是否需要下一阶细化的一般性阶匹配准则；(3) 推导出K=π处完整强耦合基态渐近展开，包含1/μ阶系数；(4) 确定了谱隙，并证明了Fredholm行列式低估因子恒等于2；(5) 确认K=0处的既有常数正确且无需细化；(6) 建立了与拓扑带结构宇称分类的结构性类比。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过精确闭式基准与一般阶匹配准则，完整解决了奇异准动量K=π处三玻色子格点算子的强耦合渐近分析。Fredholm行列式低估因子2的精确证明以及K=0常数的独立验证增强了结果的可靠性，而阶匹配判据为其他奇异准动量或更一般格点少体模型提供了通用的分析框架。

title: State-resolved quantum transport of vortex electrons in accelerators
summary: We develop a density-matrix theory of vortex-electron transport in accelerator lattices. In a periodic round lattice, the protected object is a Lewis-Floquet orbital angular momentum (OAM) invariant rather than the instantaneous kinetic OAM. Ideal transport has a metaplectic lift; stochastic imperfections generate a Lindblad channel. Dipole noise produces removable centroid smearing; quadrupole noise drives intrinsic $Δ\ell=\pm2$ leakage. Under explicit white-noise benchmarks, the inverse initial leakage scale is $2\times10^5$ turns for IOTA and $2\times10^6$ turns for PETRA III.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套描述涡旋电子在加速器晶格中输运的密度矩阵理论。在周期性圆晶格中，受保护的不变量是Lewis-Floquet轨道角动量（OAM）不变量，而非瞬时动力学OAM。理想输运具有辛提升（metaplectic lift）结构；随机缺陷产生Lindblad信道。偶极子噪声导致可去除的质心模糊，四极子噪声导致内在的Δℓ=±2泄漏。在显式白噪声基准下，IOTA的反向初始泄漏尺度为2×10⁵圈，PETRA III为2×10⁶圈。
AI.motivation: 涡旋电子束（携带轨道角动量）在粒子加速器中的输运尚未有严格的量子力学描述。此前缺乏一个统一框架来刻画理想输运与随机噪声扰动下OAM的演化与退化，特别是区分可恢复的质心效应与不可逆的内在泄漏机制。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵形式建立涡旋电子在加速器晶格中的输运理论。关键方法包括：（1）将周期性圆晶格中受保护的量识别为Lewis-Floquet OAM不变量；（2）利用metaplectic lift描述理想输运的辛结构；（3）将随机孔径和缺陷建模为Lindblad信道；（4）区分偶极子噪声（仅产生可逆的质心弥散）与四极子噪声（引起固有Δℓ=±2模式泄漏）；（5）对IOTA和PETRA III进行显式白噪声数值基准测试。
AI.result: 理论揭示了涡旋电子输运的噪声退化机制：偶极子噪声只造成质心模糊（可通过平移校正去除），而四极子噪声导致不可逆的拓扑荷±2泄漏。白噪声基准给出量化的衰减时间尺度：IOTA中逆初始泄漏尺度为2×10⁵圈，PETRA III为2×10⁶圈。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明，涡旋电子在真实加速器中的相干性保持受四极子噪声主导的固有OAM泄漏限制，其寿命在10⁵-10⁶圈量级。该密度矩阵框架为评估和优化未来涡旋电子加速器实验提供了理论基础，并指出Lewis-Floquet不变量是设计长寿命OAM束流的正确设计准则。

title: Numerical methods for the simulation of quantum walks and quantum annealing
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. This paper covers the numerical details of https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01312
summary: It is known that Chebyshev based polynomial approximation gives a near-optimal rate of convergence for calculating a function of a Hermitian matrix. However, previous work has not discussed the option of true minimax approximation, nor the specifics of writing a high performance implementation with a rigorous analysis of errors. This work provides such an analysis and an open-source implementation of three approximation methods in C++.

AI.tldr: 本文针对埃尔米特矩阵函数计算，分析了基于切比雪夫多项式逼近的收敛性，首次探讨了真正极小极大逼近的选项，并提供了含严格误差分析的三种逼近方法的高性能C++开源实现。
AI.motivation: 切比雪夫多项式逼近已知对埃尔米特矩阵函数计算具有接近最优的收敛速率，但此前工作未讨论真正的极小极大逼近方案，也未提供带严格误差分析的高性能实现细节。
AI.method: 对三种多项式逼近方法进行严格的误差分析，包括切比雪夫逼近和真正的极小极大逼近，并在C++中实现高性能开源版本。
AI.result: 提供了完整的误差分析框架和三种逼近方法的高性能C++开源实现。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作填补了极小极大逼近在矩阵函数计算中的空白，并通过严格误差分析和开源实现推动了该领域的发展。

title: A sharp bound on spacetime distance from quantum entanglement
summary: Ryu-Takayanagi established how boundary entanglement encodes bulk area. We provide the metric counterpart: boundary mutual information imposes a rigorous lower bound on bulk geodesic separation that diverges logarithmically as correlations vanish. A multiscale iteration promotes this local inequality to a global obstruction to bulk connectivity. For parallel strips in AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$, the bound necessitates a quantum resolution of the classical mutual-information transition and fixes the asymptotic growth of geodesic distance.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了边界互信息与体（bulk）测地线分离之间的严格下界，该下界在关联消失时对数发散，并通过多尺度迭代将局部不等式提升为体连通性的全局障碍。在AdS5/CFT4平行带构型中，该下界要求对经典互信息相变进行量子求解，并确定了测地线距离的渐近增长行为。
AI.motivation: Ryu-Takayanagi公式确立了边界纠缠熵编码体面积的对应关系，但边界信息如何约束体几何的度量（而非面积）性质仍缺乏同类严格框架。本文旨在提供边界互信息与体测地线分离之间的度量对应物，从而补充全息对应原理中"信息-几何"的一环。
AI.method: 从边界互信息出发构造关于体测地线分离的严格不等式下界，该下界随关联趋于零而对数发散；通过多尺度迭代过程将局部不等式逐步放大为体连通性的全局阻碍；针对AdS5/CFT4中平行带的具体构型进行分析，验证下界的行为并推导测地线距离的渐近标度。
AI.result: 建立了边界互信息对体测地线分离的严格下界，其在对关联消失时呈对数发散；多尺度迭代使得该局部不等式转化为体连通性的全局阻碍。对AdS5/CFT4平行带构型，下界要求经典互信息相变需要量子修正，并确定了测地线距离的渐近增长行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了互信息的度量对应物，与Ryu-Takayanagi的面积对应形成互补，为从边界量子信息重建体几何度量性质提供了严格框架，并指出经典互信息相变必须由量子效应予以分辨。
